words.root_logic: as-（ad- 靠近）+ sist（sistere 立）+ -ance → 站到旁边把力气借出去 → 援助
words.origin: 拉丁语 assistentia ← assistere：ad-（靠近）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 是 stare 的重叠形
words.native_definition: help or support given to someone who needs it
words.core_concept: standing beside someone to take part of the load – 站到旁边替人分担一份重量
words.core_image: 他一个人扛不动那头，另一个走过来托住一角，两人同时把它抬离地面
examples: The charity offers assistance to homeless families.
She walked upstairs without any assistance.
semantic_expansions: 援助：站到旁边把自己的力气借出去
帮助：同一件事在日常小事上的说法

words.root_logic: as-（靠近）+ sist（立）+ -ant（人）→ 站在旁边搭手的那个人 → 助手
words.origin: 拉丁语 assistens（assistere 的现在分词）：ad-（靠近）+ sistere（站立）
words.native_definition: a person whose job is to help someone more senior
words.core_concept: the one standing at your side to hand things over – 站在你旁边随时递东西的那个人
words.core_image: 主刀的手一伸出来，旁边那人早把钳子递到他手心里
examples: He works as a research assistant.
The shop assistant wrapped the gift for us.
semantic_expansions: 助手：站在旁边搭手的那个人
助理：同一个位置写成正式职务名

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sist（立）→ 各部分立在一处而互不抵触 → 一致的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consistens（consistere 的现在分词）：con-（一起）+ sistere（站立）——各部分站到同一处
words.native_definition: always behaving or happening in the same way, without contradiction
words.core_concept: parts standing together without knocking into each other – 各部分站在一处而互不冲撞
words.core_image: 同一块板量了三回，尺上停的都是那一格
examples: His story stayed consistent under questioning.
She is consistent in her training habits.
semantic_expansions: 一致的：几处说法立在同一位置，彼此不打架
始终如一的：把同一问法搬到时间上，每一次都立在原处

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stitu（statuere 立定）→ 一同立起整体的那一块 → 组成部分
words.origin: 拉丁语 constituens（constituere 的现在分词）：con-（一起）+ statuere（立定）← status（立住的样子）
words.native_definition: one of the parts that make up a whole, or a voter in a district
words.core_concept: one of the pieces standing together to make the whole – 与别的一同立起整体的那一块
words.core_image: 把钟拆开摆一桌，齿轮发条一样不少，合回去才走字
examples: Flour is the main constituent of bread.
He met his constituents on Saturday morning.
semantic_expansions: 组成部分/构成的：与别块一同把整体立起来的那一块
选民：一张张选票立起议员的席位，选区里的人就是这个整体里的一块

words.root_logic: estat（status 立住的状态）→ 一个人立身所凭的那份家底 → 地产
words.origin: 古法语 estat（状况、身份）← 拉丁语 status（站立的状态）；本指一个人立身所凭的身份与家产
words.native_definition: a large area of land with a house on it, or all the money and property someone leaves
words.core_concept: the standing a person has in land and property – 一个人在田产上立住的那份身家
words.core_image: 一道围墙圈住宅子、林子和几片田，从这头走到那头要半天
examples: He inherited a large estate in Kent.
Her estate was divided among three sons.
semantic_expansions: 地产/庄园：立身所凭、有围墙圈住的那片土地
遗产：人走以后留在世上的那一份身家总数

words.root_logic: state（status 立定的邦国）+ -man → 替一国立住方向的人 → 政治家
words.origin: 英语 state（← 拉丁语 status：站立的状态，引申为政体）+ man；指长于治国而非争位的人
words.native_definition: a skilled and respected political leader
words.core_concept: one who holds a whole country steady – 把整个邦国稳稳立住的那个人
words.core_image: 换过三任领袖，他还在台上，讲的仍是二十年以后的事
examples: He is remembered as a great statesman.
The old statesman advised three presidents.
semantic_expansions: 政治家：为一国立定方向的人
国务活动家：同一种人在正式场合的称法

words.root_logic: statu（statuere 立起）+ -e → 被立起来、就那样立着的人形 → 雕像
words.origin: 拉丁语 statua ← statuere（使立起）← status；本义就是「被立起来的那样东西」
words.native_definition: a carved or cast figure of a person or animal
words.core_concept: a figure set upright and left standing – 把一个人形立起来，就那样立着
words.core_image: 广场中央那尊青铜立了一百年，鸽子在他肩上换了几代
examples: A bronze statue stands in the square.
Children climbed onto the stone statue.
semantic_expansions: 雕像：石凿或铜铸的那个立着的人形
塑像：同一样东西按材料换个说法

words.root_logic: status（stare 立住的样子）→ 眼下立在哪一格上 → 地位
words.origin: 拉丁语 status（站立的样子、状态）← stare（站立）
words.native_definition: someone's rank in relation to others, or the current state of something
words.core_concept: where a thing currently stands – 眼下立在哪一格上
words.core_image: 一张座次图，谁坐哪一排早画定了，位置一换满场都看得出
examples: She has achieved high status in the firm.
Please check the status of my order.
semantic_expansions: 地位/身份：人在众人当中立住的那一格
状况：把同一问法用在事情上，它此刻立到了哪一步

words.root_logic: statut（statuere 立定）→ 被正式立下、从此立在那里的一条 → 法规
words.origin: 拉丁语 statutum（statuere 的过去分词中性形：已立定的事项）← status
words.native_definition: a written law passed by a legislature
words.core_concept: a rule set upright and left standing – 被立下来、从此立在那里的一条
words.core_image: 厚册子里一条条编了号，红笔圈住的那条今天起开始管人
examples: The statute was passed last year.
Such acts are forbidden by statute.
semantic_expansions: 法规/条例：正式立下、写进册子的那一条
成文法：与口传的惯例相对，强调它立在纸面上

words.root_logic: super-（在上面）+ stit（stare 立）→ 在道理之上多立出来的一层敬畏 → 迷信
words.origin: 拉丁语 superstitio ← superstare：super-（在上）+ stare（站立）——多出来、立在事理之上的那层敬畏
words.native_definition: a belief that certain acts or objects bring luck, not based on reason
words.core_concept: an extra layer standing above what reason supports – 在道理之上多立出来的一层
words.core_image: 出门非要绕开那块井盖，绕不过去就宁可回屋再坐一会儿
examples: Fear of black cats is a common superstition.
Sailors once held many superstitions.

words.root_logic: al-（ad- 朝）+ lev（levare 使变轻）+ -ate → 把压着的分量卸掉一部分 → 减轻
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 alleviare：ad-（朝）+ levis（轻的）、levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: to make pain or a problem less severe
words.core_concept: taking weight off so the load rides lighter – 卸掉一部分分量，担子就轻了
words.core_image: 从背包里抽出两本厚书塞给同伴，肩带立刻松了一截
examples: The pills alleviated her headache within minutes.
New roads alleviate traffic in the old town.
semantic_expansions: 减轻：把压着的分量卸掉一部分
缓解：同一个动作用在痛感或紧张上

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 向上）+ lev（levare 举）+ -ate → 托住往上送 → 举起
words.origin: 拉丁语 elevare：ex-（向上、向外）+ levare（举起）
words.native_definition: to raise something to a higher level or position
words.core_concept: sending a thing up by carrying it – 托住往上送
words.core_image: 千斤顶一下一下压，车身离地面越来越远
examples: Elevate your leg to reduce the swelling.
The win elevated him to national fame.
semantic_expansions: 举起：把东西托着往上送
提升：同一个动作用在水平与程度上
提拔：把人往上送一格

words.root_logic: e-（向上）+ lev（举）+ -or（做这事的东西）→ 一整天只管把人往上送的那个箱子 → 电梯
words.origin: 英语 elevate（← 拉丁语 elevare：ex-＋levare 举起）加 -or；美式称法，英式多作 lift
words.native_definition: a machine that carries people or goods between floors
words.core_concept: the box that does nothing but carry things up – 只管把东西往上送的那个箱子
words.core_image: 铁门一合，脚下轻轻一沉，数字牌从三跳到十七
examples: The elevator stopped between two floors.
Take the elevator to the top floor.
semantic_expansions: 电梯：楼里载人往上送的那个箱子
升降机：同一装置用在货物上的称法

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ lief（levare 使变轻）→ 压着的分量被拿走以后那口气 → 宽慰
words.origin: 古法语 relief ← relever ← 拉丁语 relevare：re-（再）+ levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: the good feeling when pain or worry stops, or help given to people in need
words.core_concept: the moment the weight comes off – 压着的那份分量被拿走的一刻
words.core_image: 电话里说人已经找到，她坐回椅子，肩膀整个塌下来
examples: She sighed with relief when the phone rang.
Food relief reached the village at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 宽慰/解脱：心上压着的那份分量被拿走的一下
救济：把别人肩上的重担卸掉一部分，送去的粮和钱就是卸掉的那部分

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ lieve（levare 使变轻）→ 把压着的重新托起来 → 减轻，或干脆自己接过来 → 解除
words.origin: 古法语 relever ← 拉丁语 relevare：re-（再）+ levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: to reduce pain or trouble, or to take over someone's duty
words.core_concept: lifting the weight off, or taking it over oneself – 把压着的托起来，或干脆自己接过来
words.core_image: 值了一夜的人交出钥匙，另一个接过来坐下，他终于能走了
examples: This ointment relieves itching at once.
A fresh guard relieved him at midnight.
semantic_expansions: 减轻：把压着的分量托起来一些
解除：整份都拿掉
接替：那份分量并没消失，是换到自己肩上

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ ecut（sequi 跟随）→ 跟着一件事走到最后一步 → 执行
words.origin: 古法语 executer ← 拉丁语 exsequi（办到底、跟到底），过去分词 exsecutus ← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to carry out a plan or order, or to put someone to death by law
words.core_concept: following a thing through to its last step – 跟着一件事走到最后一步
words.core_image: 清单上八条，他从头一条跟到末一条，每条后面补一个勾
examples: The team executed the plan without delay.
He was executed at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 执行/实施：跟着定好的步骤一路走到底
处死：依判决把刑罚跟到最后一步，这一支出自法律用语

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ ecut（跟随）+ -ive → 管着把事跟到底的那个人 → 主管
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 executivus ← 拉丁语 exsequi（办到底）← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a senior person who manages a business, or relating to carrying out decisions
words.core_concept: the one who sees decisions through – 负责把定下的事跟到底的那个人
words.core_image: 会散了，别人回工位，他留下把每条谁做、几号交，一样样交代清楚
examples: She is a senior executive at the bank.
Executive power rests with the president.
semantic_expansions: 主管/高管：管着把事办到底的那个人
执行的：形容那一支只管落实、不管定案的权力

words.root_logic: pur-（pro- 向前）+ sue（sequi 跟随）→ 咬住不放地一路跟下去 → 追赶
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 pursuer ← 通俗拉丁语 *prosequere ← 拉丁语 prosequi：pro-（向前）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to chase someone, or to keep working toward something over time
words.core_concept: staying on something's heels until you have it – 咬住不放，一路跟到手
words.core_image: 猎狗咬着那股气味不松口，前面拐几个弯它就跟几个弯
examples: Police pursued the car for ten miles.
She pursued a career in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 追赶：跟在后头不放，要把人或车追上
追求：跟着的不是人而是一个目标
继续从事：一件事跟着做下去，中间不断

words.root_logic: secundus（sequi 跟随）→ 紧跟在头一个后面的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 second ← 拉丁语 secundus（跟着来的、下一个）← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: coming next after the first, or one sixtieth of a minute
words.core_concept: the one that comes right behind the first – 紧跟在头一个后面的那一个
words.core_image: 领奖台上他站旁边那一格，头顶的牌子比中间那块低半头
examples: She finished second in the race.
Wait a second while I lock the door.
semantic_expansions: 第二的：紧跟头一个后面的那一位
秒：一小时先分六十份是分，再分一次得到的那层就是跟着来的下一层
附议：别人先提，自己紧跟着表态赞同

words.root_logic: sue（sequi 跟随）→ 追着一桩说法一路跟进公堂 → 起诉
words.origin: 古法语 suir / sivre（跟随、追讨）← 通俗拉丁语 *sequere ← 拉丁语 sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to start a legal case against someone in court
words.core_concept: following a claim all the way into court – 追着一桩说法一路跟进公堂
words.core_image: 修车费谈了半年没结果，他把单据装进信封递进法院
examples: She sued the company for unfair dismissal.
They threatened to sue us for damages.
semantic_expansions: 起诉：追着一件事把对方带上法庭
控告：同一个动作，重在指出对方有错

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ cord（cor 心）→ 把事情送回心里存住 → 记录
words.origin: 古法语 recorder ← 拉丁语 recordari：re-（回）+ cor/cordis（心）——古人以心为记事之处，想起一件事就是把它带回心上
words.native_definition: to store facts or sounds so they can be found later, or an account so stored
words.core_concept: putting a thing back into the heart so it keeps – 把事情送回心里存着，日后还找得出来
words.core_image: 每天收摊后把当天的进出一笔笔写进本子，到年底翻得出来
examples: She recorded every payment in a notebook.
He broke the world record last night.
semantic_expansions: 记录：把发生过的事存住，回头调得出来
纪录：存下来的那些里最高的一条
唱片：把声音存进一张盘，转起来又放得出来

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ cord（心）+ -er → 替人把事存住的那一个 → 录音机
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 recordour ← 中世纪拉丁语 recordator ← recordari（记在心上）← cor（心）
words.native_definition: a machine that stores sound or images, or an official who keeps records
words.core_concept: whatever keeps things for you so nothing is lost – 替你把东西存住、不让它丢掉的那一个
words.core_image: 桌上小盒亮着一点红，谈了一小时，回头能一句句放出来
examples: Turn on the recorder before the interview begins.
The court recorder read her notes aloud.
semantic_expansions: 录音机：把声音存住、回头放得出来的机器
记录员：做同一件事的人，存的是庭上说过的话

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ grat（gratus 令人愉快）+ -ulate → 跟着对方一起高兴，还当面说出来 → 祝贺
words.origin: 拉丁语 congratulari：com-（一同）+ gratulari（表示欢喜）← gratus（受欢迎的、令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: to tell someone you are pleased about their success
words.core_concept: joining in someone else's gladness out loud – 跟着别人一起高兴，还要说出来
words.core_image: 名单贴出来，她冲过去握住那人的手一直摇
examples: I congratulated her on passing the exam.
They congratulated him warmly after the match.
semantic_expansions: 祝贺：跟着对方一起欢喜并当面讲出来
道贺：同一件事，重在把这句话送到

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ grat（令人愉快）+ -ation → 与人同喜时递过去的那句话
words.origin: 拉丁语 congratulatio ← congratulari：com-（一同）+ gratulari（表示欢喜）← gratus（令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: words said to someone to show you are pleased about their success
words.core_concept: the words handed over when you share someone's gladness – 与人同喜时递过去的那句话
words.core_image: 门口堆着七八张卡片，每张翻开都是同一个意思，只是字不一样
examples: Please accept my congratulations on your wedding.
Cards of congratulation filled the table.
semantic_expansions: 祝贺：与人同喜这件事本身
贺词：把这份同喜写成或说成的那几句

words.root_logic: grat（gratus 白送的好意）+ -itude → 把对方那份不要钱的好一直记着 → 感激
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 gratitudo ← 拉丁语 gratus（受欢迎的、令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: the feeling of being thankful for what someone has done
words.core_concept: holding on to a kindness that was given free – 把白得的那份好意一直记着
words.core_image: 当年借他钱的人早忘了，他每逢过节还是提两盒东西上门
examples: She expressed her gratitude in a short letter.
He owed a debt of gratitude to his teacher.
semantic_expansions: 感激：记着对方白送的那份好
感恩：同一份心情，重在长久记住并想着报答

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sens（sentire 感觉）→ 一屋子人摸到的是同一个点 → 共识
words.origin: 拉丁语 consensus ← consentire：com-（一起）+ sentire（感觉、察觉）
words.native_definition: general agreement among a group of people
words.core_concept: everyone feeling their way to the same point – 各人自己去感，落到的是同一处
words.core_image: 争了两小时，最后一轮举手，屋里没有一只手往下按
examples: The committee reached a consensus after long debate.
There is no consensus on the cause.
semantic_expansions: 共识：众人各自感到而落在同一处
一致意见：这份共同的感觉写成正式结论

words.root_logic: non-（不）+ sense（sentire 感觉、理会）→ 声音到了，里头没有可理会的东西 → 胡说
words.origin: 英语 non-（不）+ sense（← 拉丁语 sensus ← sentire 感觉、察觉）
words.native_definition: words or ideas that have no meaning or are clearly untrue
words.core_concept: sound arriving with nothing in it to take hold of – 声音到了，里头没有可抓的东西
words.core_image: 他讲了五分钟，每个字都听清了，连起来却抓不住一件事
examples: Don't talk nonsense about the money.
The report was dismissed as complete nonsense.
semantic_expansions: 胡说：说出来的话里没有能让人理会的内容
废话：有话没料，听完等于没听
荒唐事：同样的空，落在做法上而不在话上

words.root_logic: sens（sentire 感觉）+ -itive → 别人察觉不到的动静，它也感到 → 敏感的
words.origin: 古法语 sensitif ← 中世纪拉丁语 sensitivus ← 拉丁语 sensus ← sentire（感觉）
words.native_definition: quick to feel or react to small changes, or easily upset
words.core_concept: feeling what most would not notice at all – 旁人根本没察觉的动静，它已经感到
words.core_image: 天平盘里放一根头发，指针就晃出半格
examples: Her skin is sensitive to strong sunlight.
This is a sensitive topic at home.
semantic_expansions: 敏感的：极小的动静也感得到
灵敏的：同一性质用在仪器上，读数跟着微动走
易受伤的：感得太清，一句话就扎进去

words.root_logic: clos（claudere 关）+ -et（小）→ 一扇门关住的那一小块地方 → 壁橱
words.origin: 古法语 closet（小间），是 clos（← 拉丁语 clausum，claudere 的过去分词）的指小形
words.native_definition: a small room or cupboard for storing clothes and things
words.core_concept: a small space shut away behind a door – 一扇门关住的那一小块地方
words.core_image: 走廊尽头那扇窄门推开，里面挂满外套，人进去转身都难
examples: She hung her coat in the closet.
Old shoes filled the hall closet.
semantic_expansions: 壁橱：嵌在墙里、关着门放衣物的那一格
储物间：同一个关起来的小空间，大到人能走进去

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ clus（claudere 关）+ -ion → 把散着的话头收齐，然后关上门 → 结论
words.origin: 拉丁语 conclusio ← concludere：com-（一并）+ claudere（关闭）——把话头一并收拢关起来
words.native_definition: the end of something, or a judgment reached after thinking
words.core_concept: shutting the door once the parts are gathered in – 各部分收齐了，就把门关上
words.core_image: 谈到末尾，他把散在桌上的纸叠齐推到中间，说就这样定了
examples: They came to the same conclusion independently.
The conclusion of the film surprised everyone.
semantic_expansions: 结论：把各处说法收拢后关上门定下的那一句
结尾：同一个关门动作用在过程上
推断：从手里已有的往下收，收到能关上为止

words.root_logic: curr（currere 跑）+ -iculum → 学的人得从头跑到尾的那一整圈 → 课程
words.origin: 拉丁语 curriculum（跑道、一圈路程）← currere（跑）
words.native_definition: the whole set of courses taught in a school or on a program
words.core_concept: the full track a learner is meant to run – 学的人得从头跑到尾的那一整圈
words.core_image: 墙上贴着三年的格子表，从头一格排到末一格，中间不许空
examples: The school revised its curriculum last year.
Latin is no longer on the curriculum.
semantic_expansions: 课程：要一门门跑完的那一整套
教学大纲：把这一整圈写下来的那张单子

words.root_logic: oc-（ob- 迎面）+ curr（跑）+ -ence → 迎面跑到眼前来的那一下
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 occurrentia ← 拉丁语 occurrere：ob-（朝着）+ currere（跑）——迎面跑来
words.native_definition: something that happens, or the fact of something happening
words.core_concept: a thing running up to meet you – 一件事迎面跑到你眼前
words.core_image: 这条路上的追尾一个月三回，住户连门都不出来看了
examples: Such storms are a rare occurrence here.
The occurrence of errors dropped sharply.
semantic_expansions: 事件：迎面撞上来的那一件
发生：不数件数，只说撞上来这回事
出现：同一个动作，重在从没有到露面

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ fus（fundere 倒）+ -ion → 几样东西倒进一个盆，哪样是哪样都分不出 → 混乱
words.origin: 拉丁语 confusio ← confundere：com-（一起）+ fundere（倒出）——倒到一处搅在一块
words.native_definition: a state in which people do not understand what is happening, or things are mixed up
words.core_concept: things poured into one basin until none can be told apart – 全倒进一个盆，哪样是哪样都分不出
words.core_image: 广播换了三次登机口，一群人拖着箱子在大厅里对着走
examples: The announcement caused confusion among passengers.
There is some confusion over the dates.
semantic_expansions: 混乱：几样东西倒到一处，秩序就没了
困惑：人心里也被倒成一片，抓不住头绪
混淆：两样本该分开的被倒在了一起

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ merc（merx 货）+ -ial → 围着货物换手长出来的那一摊事 → 商业的
words.origin: 拉丁语 commercium（贸易）：com-（一起）+ merx（属格 mercis：货物）
words.native_definition: relating to buying and selling, or a paid advertisement on radio or television
words.core_concept: everything that gathers around goods changing hands – 围着货物换手这件事长出来的一摊
words.core_image: 一整层楼全租给了店铺，早上八点卷帘门一家家往上拉
examples: The building is used for commercial purposes.
A loud commercial interrupted the film.
semantic_expansions: 商业的：与买进卖出货物有关的
商用的：同一形容词落在用途上，不是自家使唤而是拿来赚钱
广告：广播电视里为卖货插进来的那一段

words.root_logic: merchand（marcheant 贩货的人）+ -ise → 摆出来等人问价的那批东西 → 商品
words.origin: 古法语 marcheandise ← marcheant（商人）← 通俗拉丁语 mercatans ← mercari（买卖）← merx（货物）
words.native_definition: goods that are bought and sold
words.core_concept: the goods themselves, set out to be traded – 摆出来供交换的那批东西本身
words.core_image: 布摊在地上，一样样码开，标签朝上，等人蹲下来翻
examples: The shop sells sports merchandise online.
Damaged merchandise was sent back.
semantic_expansions: 商品：进来再卖出去的那批东西
货物：同一批东西，重在它是要装要运的实物

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 朝各处）+ rect（regere 引成直线）+ -ion → 把线引向哪一边 → 方向
words.origin: 拉丁语 dirigere（引成一条直线）的名词形：dis-（分开、朝各处）+ -rigere（← regere 引导、使直）
words.native_definition: the line along which something moves or points, or an instruction on what to do
words.core_concept: the straight line a thing is guided along – 把东西引着走的那一条直线
words.core_image: 岔路口三块木牌各指一边，脚下的土路却只有一条
examples: The wind changed direction after midnight.
Follow the directions on the packet.
semantic_expansions: 方向：被引出来的那条线朝着哪一边
指示：把该走的那条线讲给别人听
管理：替一群人把线引直，带着他们走

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 向上）+ rect（regere 引直）→ 把歪着的引成直的，一直引到立起来 → 竖立
words.origin: 拉丁语 erigere 的过去分词入英语：ex-（向上）+ -rigere（← regere 引导、使直）
words.native_definition: to build or set something upright, or standing straight up
words.core_concept: guided straight upward until it stands – 被引成直的，一直引到立起来
words.core_image: 四个人扶着旗杆，绳子一收，杆子从斜着变成笔直
examples: They erected a fence around the field.
He sat erect on the wooden bench.
semantic_expansions: 竖立：把躺着或歪着的引直、立起来
建造：立起来的是一整座房或一道墙
直立的：形容已经立成直的那个样子

words.root_logic: champagne（Campania ← campus 平野）→ 拿一片平野的地名当自己的名字 → 只有那儿产的才叫这个
words.origin: 法语 Champagne（法国东北一地区名）← 晚期拉丁语 Campania ← campus（平坦原野）；此酒因产地得名
words.native_definition: a sparkling white wine from one region of northern France
words.core_concept: the wine named after one stretch of open country – 拿一片平野的地名当自己名字的那种酒
words.core_image: 木塞一声顶开，杯壁上一串细泡从底一直冒到口
examples: They opened a bottle of champagne.
Champagne was served after the ceremony.

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cit（citare 唤起、催动）+ -ment → 被叫起来的那股劲在里头翻腾 → 兴奋
words.origin: 英语 excite（← 拉丁语 excitare：ex-（向外）+ citare 唤起、催动）加 -ment
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of eagerness, or a state of lively activity
words.core_concept: the stir called up inside a person – 被叫起来的那股劲在人里头翻腾
words.core_image: 开场前十分钟，看台上的人已经坐不住，脚在铁板上一直踩
examples: The children could not hide their excitement.
Her voice shook with excitement.
semantic_expansions: 兴奋：心里那股被唤起来的劲
激动：同一股劲更急更满，压都压不住
热闹：一群人的这股劲聚在一处的场面

words.root_logic: cred（credere 相信、托付）+ -ential → 让不认识的人也肯信你的那张纸 → 凭证
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 credentialis ← credentia（信任、凭信）← 拉丁语 credere（相信、把东西托付出去）
words.native_definition: a document or qualification showing that someone is trusted or qualified
words.core_concept: the paper that makes a stranger willing to trust you – 让不认识的人也肯信你的那张纸
words.core_image: 门口的人伸手要东西，他从内袋抽出一张卡，对方看一眼就让路
examples: She showed her credentials at the gate.
His credentials as a teacher are excellent.
semantic_expansions: 凭证：递出去换取信任的那件东西
资格证明：证明你够格做这件事的那一份
证书：写成正式文件的那一张

words.root_logic: sug-（sub- 从下）+ gest（gerere 携带）+ -ion → 从下方悄悄带上来、轻轻递给人的那个意思 → 建议
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 suggestioun ← 拉丁语 suggestio ← suggerere：sub-（从下）+ gerere（携带、承载）
words.native_definition: an idea put forward for someone to consider, or a hint of something
words.core_concept: an idea carried up from below and offered quietly – 从下方悄悄带上来、轻轻递到人跟前的那个意思
words.core_image: 会上没人接话，他从桌下递过一张字条，上面只写了两行
examples: Her suggestion saved us two days of work.
There was a suggestion of doubt in his tone.
semantic_expansions: 建议/意见：把想法带上台面供人考虑
暗示：不明说，只把意思带出来一点

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ cline（clinare 倾斜）→ 顺着斜面往低处走 → 下降；把递来的往旁一偏 → 谢绝
words.origin: 古法语 decliner ← 拉丁语 declinare：de-（向下）+ clinare（使倾斜）；clinare 与希腊语 klinein（倾斜）同出一源
words.native_definition: to become weaker or fewer, or to politely refuse something
words.core_concept: tipping downward, or tilting a thing aside – 顺着斜面往下走，或把递来的往旁一偏
words.core_image: 折线从左肩一路走到右下角，最后两格几乎贴到底线
examples: Sales declined sharply in the second year.
He declined the invitation with thanks.
semantic_expansions: 下降/衰退：顺着那道斜面一路往低处走
谢绝：把递到面前的东西往旁边偏开，不是硬推回去

words.root_logic: mus（Mousa 缪斯）+ -eum（处所）→ 为缪斯那几门技艺留出来的一所屋子 → 博物馆
words.origin: 拉丁语 museum ← 希腊语 mouseion（缪斯的处所，本指学者聚在一处研习的地方）← Mousa（缪斯）
words.native_definition: a building where objects of art, history, or science are kept and shown
words.core_concept: a house kept for the arts the Muses grant – 为缪斯所赐的那几门技艺留出来的一所屋子
words.core_image: 玻璃柜一排排立着，每件东西下面压一张小卡片，走廊里只有脚步声
examples: The museum opens at ten every day.
We spent the afternoon in the science museum.
semantic_expansions: 博物馆：把值得留住的东西集在一处供人看的屋子
展览馆：同一类屋子，重在里头的东西是摆出来给人看的

words.root_logic: ori（oriri 升起）+ -ent（正在）→ 日头正升起来的那一边，拿它当准头 → 定位
words.origin: 古法语 orient ← 拉丁语 oriens（oriri 的现在分词：正升起的，指日出之处）
words.native_definition: to find your position or adjust to a new situation, or the lands of the east
words.core_concept: taking your bearing from where the sun comes up – 拿日头出来的那一边当准头
words.core_image: 拿着地图在陌生街口转了半圈，把纸上的路和脚下的路对上
examples: It took her a week to orient herself.
Ships once sailed to the orient for silk.
semantic_expansions: 东方：日头升起来的那一边
定位：拿那一边当准头，把自己摆正
适应：到了新地方，一点点把自己摆正

words.root_logic: poss（posse 能够）+ -ible + -ly → 落在办得到的范围里，但没说一定 → 可能
words.origin: 英语 possible（← 拉丁语 possibilis ← posse 能够）加 -ly
words.native_definition: perhaps, or by any chance at all
words.core_concept: within what could happen, not what will – 落在办得到的范围里，但没说一定
words.core_image: 他抬头看了看云，说下午出门伞还是带上
examples: She may possibly arrive before noon.
We cannot possibly finish it tonight.
semantic_expansions: 可能/也许：办得到，只是不保证会这样
尽可能：把办得到的这个范围一直用到边上

words.root_logic: qual（qualis 何种成色）+ -itative → 问的是哪一种成色，不是有多少 → 定性的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus ← 拉丁语 qualitas（性质）← qualis（何种、什么样的）
words.native_definition: relating to the nature or kind of something rather than its amount
words.core_concept: asking what kind, never how many – 问的是哪一种成色，不是有多少
words.core_image: 两块布不称重也不量尺，只对着光看纹路粗细
examples: The study used qualitative methods only.
This is a qualitative change, not a small one.
semantic_expansions: 定性的：只判成色与种类，不出数目
性质上的：同一个意思用在变化上，变的是种类而不是量

words.root_logic: solu（solvere 解开）+ -ble（可以）→ 放进合适的水里就自己散开 → 可溶的
words.origin: 古法语 soluble ← 晚期拉丁语 solubilis ← 拉丁语 solvere（解开、松开）
words.native_definition: able to be dissolved in liquid, or able to be worked out
words.core_concept: coming undone when put in the right liquid – 放进合适的水里就自己散开
words.core_image: 一勺白粉倒进温水，搅两圈杯底就干净了
examples: Sugar is soluble in warm water.
The problem proved soluble after all.
semantic_expansions: 可溶的：进了液体就散开，结不成块
可解决的：同一个散开用在难题上，缠着的那团能被抽松

words.root_logic: tempt（temptare 试探）+ -ation → 有东西伸过来试一试你顶不顶得住 → 诱惑
words.origin: 古法语 temptacion ← 拉丁语 temptatio ← temptare（试探、考验）
words.native_definition: a strong wish to have or do something you know you should avoid
words.core_concept: something reaching out to test whether you will hold – 有东西伸过来试一试你顶不顶得住
words.core_image: 冰箱门开着，那块蛋糕就在眼前，他站着看了十几秒又关上
examples: She resisted the temptation to reply.
Cheap loans are a real temptation.
semantic_expansions: 诱惑：那股一直来试探你的拉力
引诱：把这股拉力看成别人有意做的动作
诱人的东西：专来试你的那件东西本身

words.root_logic: torm（torquere 拧）+ -ment → 被一圈圈拧紧，还不放开 → 折磨
words.origin: 古法语 torment ← 拉丁语 tormentum（靠扭绞发力的刑具、绞索）← torquere（扭转、拧）
words.native_definition: severe suffering, or to make someone suffer in this way
words.core_concept: being twisted tighter and never let go – 被一圈圈拧紧，还不放开
words.core_image: 疼从后腰起来，一阵一阵拧上去，半夜翻来覆去躺不平
examples: The noise tormented him for weeks.
She lived in torment after the accident.
semantic_expansions: 折磨：一下一下拧着不放的那个动作
痛苦：被拧住的人身上那份感受
纠缠：拧的人反复来，缠着不肯松手

words.root_logic: pre-（prae- 更、在前）+ vail（valere 有力）→ 力气比对方足，最后立住的是这一边 → 占优势
words.origin: 古法语 prevaler ← 拉丁语 praevalere：prae-（更、在前）+ valere（强壮、有力）
words.native_definition: to win in the end, or to be common in a place or time
words.core_concept: being the stronger one, so it is your side that stands – 力气占上头，最后立住的是你这边
words.core_image: 两队拔了十分钟，绳结终于一寸寸挪过白线
examples: Common sense prevailed in the end.
This custom still prevails in the north.
semantic_expansions: 占优势/获胜：力气比对方足，最后压了过去
流行：某个做法在四周力量最大，到处都是它

words.origin: 古法语 corde ← 拉丁语 chorda（琴弦、肠制的弦）← 希腊语 khorde（肠、弦）；与拉丁语 cor（心）同形而不同源，与 chord 是一对同源双式词
words.native_definition: a length of thick string or thin rope, or an insulated electrical wire
words.core_concept: a twisted length strong enough to bind things – 拧成一股、拉得住东西的那一段
words.core_image: 两股麻拧在一起，两头磨得发白，捆过很多回，边上起了毛
examples: He tied the box with a nylon cord.
The lamp cord runs behind the sofa.
semantic_expansions: 绳索/细绳：拧成股的那一段，捆东西用
电线：外面包一层皮的那一根，形状与用法都照着它来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 entre-（在中间）+ ferir（击打）← 拉丁语 ferire（打、击中）——两下从中间互击；与表「搬运」的 fer- 一支不同源
words.native_definition: to get involved in something without being asked, or to disturb a signal
words.core_concept: striking in from between so the two no longer meet clean – 从中间插进来打一下，两头就接不干净了
words.core_image: 两人正说着，第三个声音从中间插进来，谁的话都听不完整
examples: Do not interfere in other people's business.
Tall buildings interfere with the signal.
semantic_expansions: 干涉/干预：把自己插到别人中间去搅一脚
干扰：插进来的是杂音杂物，传过去的东西就不干净
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 complangere（拍胸哀号）：com-（一同）+ plangere（拍打、击打），经古法语入英语；与表「平」的那一支同形而不同源
words.native_definition: to say that you are unhappy or that something is wrong
words.core_concept: beating the chest so others hear the hurt – 拍着胸口出声，让旁人听见这份不好受
words.core_image: 队排到窗口，他把单子往台面上一拍，声音比刚才高了两度
examples: She complained about the cold soup.
Guests complained to the manager twice.
semantic_expansions: 抱怨：出声说自己不好受
投诉：把这份不好受正式递到管事的人跟前
诉说：说的是身上的病痛苦处
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 compleinte（动词 compleindre 的过去分词名词化）← 中世纪拉丁语 complangere：com-（一同）+ plangere（拍打、拍胸哀号）
words.native_definition: a statement that something is wrong, or an illness
words.core_concept: the chest-beating put into words and handed over – 那份拍着胸口的不好受，写成一件递上去的东西
words.core_image: 意见箱里抽出十几张纸，八张写的是同一部电梯
examples: The hotel received three complaints last week.
A chest complaint kept him at home.
semantic_expansions: 抱怨：说出来的那份不好受
投诉：正式递上去的那一件
疾病：身上不舒服的那一处，也是同一种说自己难受
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ fus（倒）+ -al → 把递来的东西倒回去这件事 → 拒绝
words.origin: 英语 refuse 加 -al；refuse ← 古法语 refuser ← 拉丁语 refundere：re-（往回）+ fundere（倒出）——PIE *ǵʰewd-「倒」那一支
words.native_definition: an act of saying no to something offered or requested
words.core_concept: the no handed back when something is offered – 东西递过来，把不接受原样递回去
words.core_image: 请帖原样退回，信封上另贴一张字条，只有两行客气话
examples: His refusal surprised everyone at the table.
She gave a polite refusal by letter.
semantic_expansions: 拒绝：明确说不接受
谢绝：同一个不接受，说得客气些

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pend（称量）→ expendere：称出银子付出去 → 付出去的那笔量
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 expenditura ← 拉丁语 expenditus / expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量、付出）
words.native_definition: the total amount of money or effort that is spent
words.core_concept: money weighed out and paid away – 称出来付出去的那一份
words.core_image: 账本最后一行写着这个月从库房里搬出去的银钱总数
examples: The company cut its expenditure last year.
Public expenditure on health rose sharply.
semantic_expansions: 支出：从账上称出去、不再回来的钱
花费：为一件事付出去的钱数
消耗：不只是钱，体力和时间也这么一份份称出去

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pens（称量）→ 称出来交出去的那一笔
words.origin: 古法语 espense（花掉的钱）← 晚期拉丁语 expensa ← 拉丁语 expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: the money that something costs you, or a cost you have to bear
words.core_concept: what a thing weighs out of your purse – 一件事从你钱袋里称走的那一份
words.core_image: 出差回来把一叠票据摊在桌上，一张张加起来交给财务
examples: The trip was worth the expense.
She won at the expense of her health.
semantic_expansions: 费用：办一件事要交出去的钱数
开支：一段时间里陆续交出去的那些钱
代价：交出去的不是钱而是别的东西，如健康

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ de-（往下）+ pend（挂）→ 不从别的东西上垂下来
words.origin: 法语 indépendance ← in-（不）＋dépendance ← 拉丁语 dependere：de（往下）＋pendere（挂）
words.native_definition: the state of not being controlled or supported by others
words.core_concept: not hanging from anything else – 不从别的东西上垂下来
words.core_image: 一盏灯自己立在地上，不靠墙，也没从房梁上垂下来
examples: The colony won its independence in 1947.
She values her financial independence.
semantic_expansions: 独立：不挂在别人身上，自己站得住
自主：自己的事自己定，不用等上头点头

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ de-（往下）+ pend（挂）→ 不吊在谁身上的
words.origin: 法语 indépendant ← in-（不）＋dépendant ← 拉丁语 dependens（正挂着的）← dependere
words.native_definition: not relying on or controlled by other people or things
words.core_concept: standing without hanging on another – 不吊在别人身上也站得住
words.core_image: 两根柱子各自扎在土里，抽掉一根，另一根照样站着
examples: She has been independent since she was eighteen.
Two independent teams checked the data.
semantic_expansions: 独立的：不靠别人支撑，自己立着
自主的：自己决定自己的事，不受人指派
无党派的：不挂靠任何一方的旗号

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ dispens（按份称出去、分派，← pendere 称量）+ -able → 这一份免不掉、划不掉
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 indispensabilis（不可豁免的）← in-（不）＋dispensare（按份称出、分派）：dis（分开）＋pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: so necessary that you cannot manage without it
words.core_concept: the one share that cannot be weighed away – 唯一不能从分派里划掉的那份
words.core_image: 清点行李时把这一件挑出来放回箱底，别的都能扔
examples: Water is indispensable to life.
She became indispensable to the team.
semantic_expansions: 不可缺少的：抽掉它整件事就散了
必不可少的：非有它不行，找不到替代

words.root_logic: pend（挂）+ -ulum（小东西）→ pendulus：吊着自己晃的那一件
words.origin: 拉丁语 pendulus（悬着的、摆动的）← pendere（悬挂）
words.native_definition: a weight hung from a fixed point that swings freely back and forth
words.core_concept: a weight left hanging so that it swings – 吊在一点上、自己来回晃的一块重物
words.core_image: 一根线吊着铜块，推一下就左右来回，每次都过同一个最低点
examples: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly.
Public opinion swings like a pendulum.
semantic_expansions: 摆：吊在一点上来回晃动的那件重物
钟摆：钟里靠这个来回来定时间的那一根

words.root_logic: pens（称量）+ -io → pensio：按期称出银子付给你的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 pencion（付款）← 拉丁语 pensio（付款、分期支付）← pendere（称量、付钱）
words.native_definition: money paid regularly to someone who has retired from work
words.core_concept: a fixed amount weighed out to you each period – 每期按定量称给你的那一笔
words.core_image: 每月同一天，柜台里数出同样厚的一叠钞票，交给不再上班的人
examples: He lives on a small pension.
She pays into a pension every month.
semantic_expansions: 养老金：年纪大了以后按期领到的那笔钱
退休金：不再上班后由原单位或国家按期付的钱

words.root_logic: pond（重量，← pendere 称量）+ -er → 把事情放到秤上一遍遍称
words.origin: 古法语 ponderer（衡量）← 拉丁语 ponderare（称重、掂量）← pondus（重量）← pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: to think about something carefully for a long time
words.core_concept: putting a matter on the scales in your head – 把事情放到心里的秤上称
words.core_image: 两个选择摆在眼前，他坐着不动，来回比这个重还是那个重
examples: She pondered the question for a while.
He pondered over what to do next.
semantic_expansions: 沉思：把一件事放在心里久久称量
仔细考虑：一条条比过轻重再定
掂量：在几样里反复比，挑分量合适的那个

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ pend（称量）→ expendere：称出银子付出去 → 钱和时间都这么一份份付掉
words.origin: 古英语 -spendan（用掉，见于 forspendan）← 拉丁语 expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量、付出）
words.native_definition: to pay out money, or to use up time on something
words.core_concept: to weigh out what you have and hand it over – 把自己有的称出来交出去
words.core_image: 手伸进口袋掏出几枚硬币放到柜台上，口袋跟着轻了
examples: They spend too much on food.
We spent the summer by the sea.
semantic_expansions: 花费：把钱称出去交给别人
度过：时间也这么一份份用出去，如过完一个夏天
用尽：把手上那点量全付光

words.root_logic: spec（看）+ -ies → species：看上去的那副样子 → 样子相同的归成一类
words.origin: 拉丁语 species（外观、样子、类别）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: a group of living things that look alike and can breed together
words.core_concept: the look shared by all of one kind – 同一类共有的那副模样
words.core_image: 标本柜同一格里的几只鸟，喙的弧度和羽色几乎一模一样
examples: This species of frog lives only here.
Many species are dying out.
semantic_expansions: 物种：外形相同、彼此能繁育的一群生物
种类：泛指长得一样、被归到一起的一批东西

words.root_logic: speci（样子、类，← specere 看）+ -fic（造成）→ 只落在这一类上，不涉别的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 specificus（成一类的）← species（类别、样子）＋-ficus（造成…的）
words.native_definition: clearly stated and applying to one thing only
words.core_concept: pinned to one kind and no other – 只钉在这一类上，不涉其余
words.core_image: 他不说哪天都行，直接伸手指着日历上那一格
examples: Give me a specific example.
The drug works on one specific virus.
semantic_expansions: 具体的：细到能指出是哪一个
特定的：单指这一个，不是同类里随便哪个
明确的：说到位了，不给人猜的余地

words.root_logic: spec（看）+ -men（用来做某事的东西）→ 取出来专给人看的那一件
words.origin: 拉丁语 specimen（用来看的样品、标志）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: a single example of something, taken so that it can be examined
words.core_concept: the one piece taken out to be looked at – 取出来专供人细看的那一件
words.core_image: 玻璃管里封着一小段取下来的东西，贴好标签送去化验
examples: The doctor took a blood specimen.
Each specimen is kept in a jar.
semantic_expansions: 样本：从整体里取一小份拿去查
标本：处理好、长期留着供人看的那件
样品：拿来代表一批货给人过目的一件

words.root_logic: specula（瞭望塔，← specere 看）+ -ate → 站塔上往远处望 → 看不清也先说出个说法
words.origin: 拉丁语 speculari（观察、远望）← specula（瞭望塔）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: to guess about something without enough facts, or to risk money hoping for profit
words.core_concept: watching from a height and guessing at what is far off – 站高处远望，看不清就先下判断
words.core_image: 站在塔顶往远处望，那边只有一团影子，他张口就说那是什么
examples: The papers speculated about her reasons.
He speculated in land and lost money.
semantic_expansions: 推测：证据不全就先给出一个说法
思索：在心里远望，把可能的情形一个个想过
投机：拿钱去赌一个要等很久才见输赢的走势

words.root_logic: su-/sub-（从下往上）+ spic（看，← specere）→ suspicere：暗暗从下往上打量 → 心里存下的那点不放心
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 suspecioun（后依拉丁语改拼）← 拉丁语 suspicio（暗中打量、猜忌）← suspicere：sub（从下）＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: a feeling that someone has done something wrong, without proof
words.core_concept: a sidelong look that keeps something back – 从底下打量一眼，心里留着一个疑
words.core_image: 他嘴上应着，眼睛却从下往上把对方扫了一遍
examples: She looked at him with suspicion.
He was arrested on suspicion of theft.
semantic_expansions: 怀疑：心里存着事情不对，却拿不出证据
嫌疑：别人看你像是干了那件事的那种处境

words.root_logic: sub-（从下）+ spic（看，← specere）+ -ous → 老在暗中打量人的，或引人这么打量的
words.origin: 古法语 sospecious ← 拉丁语 suspiciosus（多疑的、可疑的）← suspicio ← suspicere：sub（从下）＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: feeling that something is wrong, or making other people feel that
words.core_concept: either doing the sidelong looking or drawing it – 要么在暗中打量别人，要么招来这种打量
words.core_image: 半夜有人在别人车边蹲着，路过的都要多看他两眼
examples: A suspicious man waited by the gate.
She was suspicious of his story.
semantic_expansions: 可疑的：样子招人从底下打量，觉得不对
多疑的：自己老在暗中打量别人
怀疑的：眼下就对某件事存着疑

words.root_logic: man（手，← manus）+ -age + -ment → maneggiare 本是用手驯马 → 把一摊事拿在手里打理
words.origin: manage（← 意大利语 maneggiare 驯马、经手打理 ← 拉丁语 manus 手）＋-ment
words.native_definition: the work of controlling and organizing a business or a group of people
words.core_concept: keeping the reins of a thing in your own hand – 把一摊事的缰绳收在自己手里
words.core_image: 一个人手里攥着几十根缰绳，马往哪边走全看他松紧
examples: The factory needs better management.
Management refused to meet the union.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把人和事拿在手里安排，松紧由你
经营：日常打理一门生意，让它转得下去
管理层：手里握着这些缰绳的那批人

words.root_logic: man（手，← manus）+ -age + -er → 缰绳握在他手里的那个人
words.origin: manage（← 意大利语 maneggiare 驯马、经手打理 ← 拉丁语 manus 手）＋-er
words.native_definition: the person in charge of running a business or part of one
words.core_concept: the one whose hand holds the reins – 缰绳在他手里的那个人
words.core_image: 车间里出了岔子，所有人都回头看门口站着的那个人
examples: Ask the manager for a refund.
She is the manager of two shops.
semantic_expansions: 经理：一家店或一个部门的负责人
管理者：手里管着人和事的那种人
主管：某一摊具体事务归他管

words.root_logic: manu（用手，← manus）+ opera（活儿）→ manuopera：手上的活 → 靠手上功夫一寸寸挪
words.origin: 法语 manœuvre（手上的活、操作）← 中世纪拉丁语 manuopera：manu（用手）＋opera（活儿）
words.native_definition: a careful or clever movement, or to move something with skill
words.core_concept: shifting a thing by handwork, inch by inch – 靠手上功夫把东西一寸寸挪到位
words.core_image: 车位只比车长半尺，他打了七八把方向才把车塞进去
examples: He maneuvered the car into the space.
The army began a night maneuver.
semantic_expansions: 机动：部队按计划挪动位置的那种行动
巧妙移动：在窄处一点点把东西挪进去
花招：把局面一点点挪到对自己有利，多含贬义

words.origin: 拉丁语 permanens（一直留着的）← permanere：per（贯穿到底）＋manere（停留、不走）
words.native_definition: lasting for a very long time, or meant never to change
words.core_concept: staying on all the way through – 从头到尾一直留在原处
words.core_image: 墙上那块牌子二十年没换过，钉子早锈进砖里
examples: She found a permanent job.
The damage to the wall is permanent.
semantic_expansions: 永久的：一直留着，不打算取消
长期的：很长一段时间里都不变，如长期职位
固定的：位置或身份定死了，不再挪动
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: act（驱动、做，← agere）+ -ive + -ate → 把停着的东西推成动着的
words.origin: active（← 拉丁语 activus 能动的 ← actus ← agere 驱动、做）＋-ate
words.native_definition: to make something start working or take effect
words.core_concept: pushing a thing from still into motion – 把停着的东西推成动着的
words.core_image: 按下开关，原本安静的机器灯亮起来，风扇跟着转了
examples: Press this button to activate the alarm.
Heat activates the chemical in the tube.
semantic_expansions: 激活：让原本闲着的东西开始起作用
启动：从关着的状态转到开始运转
使活跃：让人或反应变得活跃起来

words.root_logic: ag（驱动、办事，← agere）+ -ent（正在办的）+ -cy → 替你去动手办事的那一方
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 agentia（办事、代办）← agens（正在做的人）← agere（驱动、做）
words.native_definition: a business that acts for other people, or the power to act
words.core_concept: the party that does the acting for you – 替你去动手办事的那一方
words.core_image: 你不出门，柜台后的人替你把票订好、把手续跑完
examples: She booked the trip through an agency.
He acted through the agency of a friend.
semantic_expansions: 代理机构：受你委托去办事的公司或部门
中介：在两方之间跑腿、促成事情的那一方
作用力：促使事情发生的那股推动

words.root_logic: ambi-（两边）+ ig（驱动，← agere）→ ambigere：往两边都赶 → 两头都说得通
words.origin: 拉丁语 ambiguus（两义的）← ambigere：ambi（两边）＋agere（驱动、赶）
words.native_definition: having more than one possible meaning, so it is not clear
words.core_concept: driving both ways at once, so neither is settled – 同时朝两边赶，哪边都没定下
words.core_image: 路口那块牌子两头都写着字，站在下面的人不知该往哪边走
examples: His answer was deliberately ambiguous.
The wording is ambiguous here.
semantic_expansions: 含糊的：话没说定，听的人抓不住
有歧义的：一句话能读出两个意思
模棱两可的：故意两边都留口子，谁也不得罪

words.root_logic: don（给，← dare）+ -ate → 把东西白交出去，不要回报
words.origin: 拉丁语 donare（赠送）← donum（礼物）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to give money or goods to a person or organization that needs them
words.core_concept: putting a thing into other hands and asking nothing back – 把东西交出去，不要回报
words.core_image: 他把一箱衣服搬到收集点，签个名就走，收条也不要
examples: She donated a thousand pounds to the school.
Many people donate blood here.
semantic_expansions: 捐赠：把财物无偿交给需要的一方
捐款：交出去的是钱
献：血、器官、力气这类也这么交出去

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ don（给，← dare）→ perdonare：把该追的整个送掉 → 不再向你追讨
words.origin: 古法语 pardoner（宽恕）← 中世纪拉丁语 perdonare：per（彻底）＋donare（给）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to forgive someone, or an official decision to free them from punishment
words.core_concept: giving the debt away instead of collecting it – 把该追的那笔整个送掉
words.core_image: 判决书还摊在桌上，长官提笔在末尾签了一行，人当天走出大门
examples: Pardon me for interrupting you.
The governor pardoned two prisoners.
semantic_expansions: 原谅：不再追究对方的过失
赦免：官方正式免掉刑罚
请再说一遍：口语里说 pardon，是请对方把话再给你一次

words.root_logic: up（往前）+ date（日期，← 拉丁语 data「给出于某日」← dare 给）→ 把日子挪到今天
words.origin: up（往上、往前）＋date（日期）；date ← 古法语 date ← 晚期拉丁语 data（文书末尾「给出于某日某地」的那个词）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to add the newest information to something, or the newest information itself
words.core_concept: bringing a thing forward to today's date – 把东西的日子挪到今天
words.core_image: 表格右上角原先印着去年的日子，他划掉，改写成今天
examples: Please update your address here.
Here is an update on the storm.
semantic_expansions: 更新：把旧内容换成当下的
最新消息：换上来的那批新内容本身

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mit（送、交，← mittere）+ -ee → 事情被送到手上的那几个人
words.origin: commit（← 拉丁语 committere：com（一起）＋mittere（送、交付））＋-ee，本指受托的人
words.native_definition: a small group of people chosen to deal with a particular matter
words.core_concept: the few into whose hands a matter is sent – 事情被送到他们手上的那一小群人
words.core_image: 长桌两侧坐着七个人，一份卷宗推到中间，散会前得给出说法
examples: The committee meets every Tuesday.
A committee was set up to review the case.

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pro-（预先）+ mis（送出，← mittere）→ 双方各把话送出去 → 各让一步
words.origin: 古法语 compromis ← 拉丁语 compromissum（双方共同许下、交付仲裁）← compromittere：com（一起）＋promittere（送出承诺）← mittere（送）
words.native_definition: an agreement in which each side gives up part of what it wanted
words.core_concept: each side sending out part of its own claim – 双方各把自己那一部分让出去
words.core_image: 两人各把要价写在纸上推到中间，最后签的数字谁都不满意
examples: They reached a compromise after long talks.
Poor sleep compromises your health.
semantic_expansions: 妥协：各放弃一部分要求，换来能成的结果
折中：在两个方案中间取一个
危及：连该守的那份也让了出去，安全或原则因此受损

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ mis（送出，← mittere）→ 提前把话送出去，收不回来
words.origin: 拉丁语 promissum（许下的话）← promittere：pro（预先）＋mittere（送出）
words.native_definition: to say firmly that you will do something, or the words you say
words.core_concept: words sent out ahead, past taking back – 提前送出去、收不回来的话
words.core_image: 他说完伸出手，两只手一握，这句话就再收不回来了
examples: He promised to call me tonight.
She shows real promise as a singer.
semantic_expansions: 承诺：预先把我会做这句话送出去
答应：对别人的请求点头，把话给出去
前景：一个人身上先露出来的那份可期待

words.root_logic: a-/ad-（朝向）+ spire（呼吸，← spirare）→ 朝那个方向使劲喘气 → 心一直往高处
words.origin: 拉丁语 aspirare（向…吹气、渴求）：ad（朝向）＋spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: to want very much to achieve something important
words.core_concept: breathing hard towards a thing far above – 朝着高处那样东西使劲喘气
words.core_image: 他仰头看着那座山顶，胸口一起一伏，脚已经在往上迈
examples: She aspires to become a judge.
Many aspire to own a house.
semantic_expansions: 渴望：心里一直朝着那样东西
追求：不只是想，还一直往那边使劲
立志：把这口气定成长远的目标

words.root_logic: spir（呼吸，← spirare）+ -itus → spiritus：一口气 → 人活着靠这口气，气也是人的劲头
words.origin: 古法语 espirit ← 拉丁语 spiritus（呼吸、气、灵）← spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: the part of a person that is not the body, or the mood and energy someone shows
words.core_concept: the breath that keeps a body alive – 让身子活着的那口气
words.core_image: 老人躺着不动了，医生说最后那口气刚才走的
examples: The team played with great spirit.
He was in low spirits all week.
semantic_expansions: 精神：人身上那股看不见的劲头
灵魂：离开身体后仍被认为存在的那一部分
情绪：这口气的高低，如兴致低落
烈酒：蒸出来的那一口，旧时被看作酒的气

words.root_logic: spirit（气、灵，← spirare 呼吸）+ -al → 归于那口气，不归于肉身的
words.origin: 古法语 spirituel ← 拉丁语 spiritualis（属于气与灵的）← spiritus ← spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: relating to the human soul rather than to the body or material things
words.core_concept: belonging to the breath, not to the flesh – 归于那口气，不归于肉身
words.core_image: 屋里没有一件值钱东西，那人却说这些年过得比谁都饱
examples: She turned to spiritual matters late in life.
The song has a spiritual quality.
semantic_expansions: 精神的：与内在那一面有关，不涉物质
心灵的：关乎内心的感受与需要
宗教的：与信仰、教会那一套有关

words.root_logic: contra-（对着）+ dict（说，← dicere）+ -ion → 对着人家的话反着说 → 两句话对撞
words.origin: 拉丁语 contradictio（反驳）← contradicere：contra（对着）＋dicere（说）
words.native_definition: a statement or fact that goes against another one
words.core_concept: one saying set against another – 一句话正对着另一句说
words.core_image: 同一份报告里，前一页写着涨了，后一页写着跌了
examples: There is a contradiction in his story.
Her actions are a contradiction of her words.
semantic_expansions: 矛盾：两句话或两件事对撞，不能同时成立
反驳：当面把对着的那句话说出来
相互抵触：几项规定彼此顶着，照哪条都违另一条

words.root_logic: dict（说，← dicere）+ -ion（说出来的词）+ -ary（存放处）→ 一条条说法收在一处
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 dictionarium（词语集）← 拉丁语 dictio（说出来的话、措辞）← dicere（说）
words.native_definition: a book that lists words in order and explains what they mean
words.core_concept: a store of how each word is said and used – 把每个词怎么说都收在一处
words.core_image: 厚厚一本按字母排下来，每个词后头跟着一小段怎么说、怎么用
examples: Look the word up in a dictionary.
She keeps a dictionary on her desk.
semantic_expansions: 词典：收词并解释词义和用法的书
字典：以单字为条目的那一种

words.root_logic: grad（一步、一级，← gradus）+ -ate → 把台阶一级级走到最后那一级
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 graduatus（已授学位的）← graduari（升级、授级）← 拉丁语 gradus（一步、等级）
words.native_definition: to finish a course of study at a school or university, or a person who has done so
words.core_concept: having climbed the last of the steps – 把台阶一级级走到了最后一级
words.core_image: 最上一级台阶上站着穿黑袍的人，回头看走过的那一级一级
examples: She graduated from Oxford last year.
Every graduate gets a printed certificate.
semantic_expansions: 毕业：把规定的级数走完，课程算结束
毕业生：走完这些台阶的那个人
分等级：把刻度或程度一级一级标出来

words.root_logic: under-（在…之下）+ grad（一级，← gradus）→ 还停在最后那一级之下的人
words.origin: under-（在…之下）＋graduate（← 中世纪拉丁语 graduatus 已授学位的 ← 拉丁语 gradus 一步、等级）
words.native_definition: a student at a university who has not yet taken a first degree
words.core_concept: still below the last step – 还停在最后那一级之下
words.core_image: 楼梯还剩几级没上，他抱着书从穿黑袍的人身边挤过去
examples: He is an undergraduate at Leeds.
Undergraduates share the same library.
semantic_expansions: 本科生：还没拿到第一个学位的在校生
大学在读生：书还没念完，仍停在台阶中段

words.root_logic: nat（出生，← nasci）+ -io（一同生出来的一群）+ -ality → 你生在哪一群人里，就算哪一国的人
words.origin: 法语 nationalité ← 拉丁语 natio（同一出生的一群人、族）← natus（生出的）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: the status of belonging to a particular country
words.core_concept: which people you were born among – 你生在哪一群人当中
words.core_image: 边检翻开证件，看的是他生在哪里、算哪一国的人
examples: She has dual nationality and two passports.
People of many nationalities work here.
semantic_expansions: 国籍：法律上算你属于哪个国家
民族：同源同俗的一群人，如少数民族

words.root_logic: nat（出生，← nasci）+ -ura（生成的样子）+ -al → 生来就那样，不是后来做上去的
words.origin: 古法语 naturel ← 拉丁语 naturalis（天生的）← natura（生就的样子）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: existing or happening without being made or changed by people
words.core_concept: the way a thing comes out when born, not made – 生下来就是那样，不是后来做出来的
words.core_image: 山坡上的林子没人栽过，树间距歪歪扭扭，落叶自己烂成土
examples: The park is a natural woodland.
It is natural to feel nervous.
semantic_expansions: 自然的：不经人手，本来就有的
天然的：材料原样，没加工也没添东西
正常的：合乎本性、不值得奇怪，如紧张

words.root_logic: em-/in-（进去）+ ploy（折，← plicare）→ implicare：把人折进事里 → 被用上、有活干
words.origin: 古法语 emploier（使用、雇用）← 拉丁语 implicare（缠进、卷入）：in（进）＋plicare（折）
words.native_definition: the state of having paid work, or the act of giving people work
words.core_concept: being folded into someone's work – 被折进一摊活里，成了其中一层
words.core_image: 早上七点，一群人拿着卡在厂门口排队打卡
examples: Employment rose slowly last year.
She is looking for full-time employment.
semantic_expansions: 就业：有活干、被折进生产里的那种状态
雇用：把人折进自己的事里，付钱让他做
工作：具体那一份被雇来做的活

words.root_logic: un-（不）+ em-（进去）+ ploy（折，← plicare）→ 没被折进任何一摊活里
words.origin: un-（不）＋employment（← 古法语 emploier ← 拉丁语 implicare：in（进）＋plicare（折））
words.native_definition: the state of having no paid work, or the number of people in that state
words.core_concept: not folded into any work at all – 没被折进任何一摊活里
words.core_image: 上午十点，一排人坐在职介所的长椅上，手里捏着号码纸
examples: Unemployment fell to five percent.
He faced six months of unemployment.
semantic_expansions: 失业：想干活却没被任何一摊活收进去
失业率：这样的人在劳动人口里占的比例

words.root_logic: soci（同伴、结伴，← socius）+ -al + -ism → 要紧的东西与同伴共同占有的那一套主张
words.origin: 法语 socialisme ← social（← 拉丁语 socialis 结伴的 ← socius 同伴）＋-isme
words.native_definition: a political system in which the community owns the main means of production
words.core_concept: holding the main things in common with your fellows – 要紧的东西与同伴共同占有
words.core_image: 厂门口的牌子写着这厂不归一个人，做工的人共同占份
examples: He wrote a long book about socialism.
The party moved away from socialism.

words.root_logic: soci（结伴、人相联，← socius）+ -logia（…之学）→ 研究人怎么结成群的学问
words.origin: 法语 sociologie ← 拉丁语 socius（同伴）＋希腊语 -logia（…之学）
words.native_definition: the study of how human societies are organized and how people behave in groups
words.core_concept: the study of how people join into groups – 研究人怎样彼此相联成群的学问
words.core_image: 研究者拿着问卷进村，记下谁跟谁走得近、谁说话管用
examples: She teaches sociology at a small college.
His sociology paper won a prize.

words.root_logic: dis-（去掉）+ charge（装车，← carrus 货车）→ 把装上车的卸回地上
words.origin: 古法语 deschargier（卸下）← 晚期拉丁语 discarricare：dis（去掉）＋carricare（装车）← 拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车）
words.native_definition: to let someone leave, to send something out, or to carry out a duty
words.core_concept: taking the load back off the cart – 把装上车的东西卸回地上
words.core_image: 车斗后板一放，一车砖哗啦倒空，车身轻了就走
examples: The factory discharges waste into the river.
He was discharged from hospital on Friday.
semantic_expansions: 排出：把积在里面的东西放出去
解雇：把某人从岗位这辆车上卸下来
出院：医院把你从名册上卸下，让你走
履行：把肩上那份担子卸掉，等于办完

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ claim（喊，← clamare）→ 冲着他喊出来 → 众人喊出来的那份好
words.origin: 拉丁语 acclamare（向…欢呼）：ad（朝向）＋clamare（喊、大声宣告）
words.native_definition: strong public praise, or to praise someone publicly
words.core_concept: shouting out towards someone in praise – 冲着某个人喊出好来
words.core_image: 幕布落下，台下站起来一片人，冲着台上又喊又拍
examples: The film won critical acclaim.
Crowds acclaimed the young champion.
semantic_expansions: 称赞：公开说他好，多见于评论界
喝彩：当场喊出来的那种叫好
欢呼：一群人同时喊，声势连成一片

words.root_logic: dom（屋、家，← domus）→ 意大利语 duomo：神的屋子、大教堂 → 教堂顶上那个半圆的盖
words.origin: 中古法语 dome ← 意大利语 duomo（大教堂，即神的屋子）← 拉丁语 domus（房屋）
words.native_definition: a rounded roof shaped like half a ball
words.core_concept: the rounded roof over a god's house – 神的屋子上那个半圆的顶
words.core_image: 抬头看，屋顶不平也不尖，是扣过来的半个球，正中开着天窗
examples: The cathedral has a huge dome.
Snow settled on the glass dome.
semantic_expansions: 圆顶：像半个球那样扣在建筑上的顶
穹顶：从屋里抬头看到的那面拱形天花

words.root_logic: fil（线，← filum）→ 法语 filer：把文书一张张串到线上 → 串在一处的那一叠，也指串成的一列
words.origin: 古法语 filer（把文书串到线上保存）← fil（线）← 拉丁语 filum（线）；与表「锉刀」的 file 不同源
words.native_definition: a set of papers or computer records kept together, or to put them in order
words.core_concept: papers strung on one thread and kept in order – 一叠纸串在同一根线上，按次序留着
words.core_image: 一根细绳穿过一叠单据的角，挂在钉子上，要查就顺着绳翻
examples: Save the file before you close it.
They walked in single file.
semantic_expansions: 文件：串在一处的那一份材料，电脑里也这么叫
档案：长期存着、按次序排好的那一叠
纵列：像串在一根线上那样一个跟一个排成的队
归档：把新的一张按位置串进去

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 humiliare（使低下）← humilis（低的，字面「贴着地面的」）← humus（泥土、地面）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel ashamed and foolish in front of other people
words.core_concept: pressing someone down to the ground – 把人按到贴着地面那么低
words.core_image: 他被叫到台前，当着满屋子人被数落了十分钟，头越垂越低
examples: He humiliated her in front of everyone.
She felt humiliated by the remark.
semantic_expansions: 羞辱：当众把人踩低
使丢脸：让他在人前抬不起头
使难堪：话说得让人只想找个地方躲
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: loco（从某个地点，← locus 地点）+ motivus（能动的）→ 自己能从一处挪到另一处的那台机器
words.origin: 法语 locomotif ← 中世纪拉丁语 locomotivus：loco（从某地，locus 的夺格）＋motivus（能动的）
words.native_definition: a railway engine that pulls a line of carriages
words.core_concept: the engine that shifts itself from place to place – 能自己从一个地点挪到另一个地点的机器
words.core_image: 前头那台黑铁家伙喷着白汽，后面一串车厢被它拽着走
examples: The locomotive pulled twelve carriages.
An old steam locomotive stood in the shed.
semantic_expansions: 机车：铁路上出力牵引的那台动力车
火车头：挂在最前面拖动整列车的那一节

words.root_logic: e-/ex-（出）+ norm（角尺，← norma）+ -ous → 大出了那把尺能比的范围
words.origin: 拉丁语 enormis（超出常规的、极大的）：ex（出）＋norma（木匠的角尺）
words.native_definition: very much bigger than usual
words.core_concept: past what the measuring square can take – 超出了那把尺能比的范围
words.core_image: 尺子拿过去比了一下，东西一头还在尺外，只好扔下尺子改用脚步量
examples: They live in an enormous house.
The task took an enormous amount of time.
semantic_expansions: 巨大的：大到常用的尺度已经量不下
庞大的：体量或规模大得笨重，如机构臃肿

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pat（承受，← pati）+ -ible → 凑在一处彼此承受得住
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 compatibilis（能共处的）← compati：com（一起）＋pati（承受、忍耐）
words.native_definition: able to exist or be used together without problems
words.core_concept: able to bear each other side by side – 凑在一处彼此承受得住
words.core_image: 新插头往旧插座里一推就到底，机器照常亮灯
examples: This printer is compatible with both systems.
Their views are not compatible.
semantic_expansions: 兼容的：两套东西配在一起能正常用
相容的：两种说法或做法并存而不冲突
合得来的：两个人凑在一处也相处得下去

words.root_logic: pract（做、实行，← prassein）+ -ice → 把想法一遍遍真做出来，做出来的那一套也叫它
words.origin: 古法语 practiser ← 中世纪拉丁语 practicare（实行）← practicus ← 希腊语 praktikos（适于行动的）← prassein（做）
words.native_definition: doing something repeatedly to get better at it, or the usual way of doing things
words.core_concept: turning an idea into something actually done, again and again – 把想法一遍遍真做出来
words.core_image: 同一段谱他弹了两百遍，手指自己会走，谱子早就合上了
examples: She needs more practice at the piano.
It is common practice here.
semantic_expansions: 练习：为练熟而反复做同一件事
实践：把道理真做出来，与空谈相对
惯例：一直这么做下来，成了固定做法
业务：医生律师这类靠实做维持的行当

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ quir（寻找，← quaerere）→ 朝一样东西找过去，找着了就归自己
words.origin: 古法语 aquerre ← 拉丁语 acquirere（取得）：ad（朝向）＋quaerere（寻找、求取）
words.native_definition: to get or come to have something, often after effort
words.core_concept: seeking a thing until it is yours – 一直找下去，直到那样东西归你
words.core_image: 他找了三年才把缺的那张邮票买到，放进册子最后一格
examples: The company acquired two small rivals.
Children acquire language very fast.
semantic_expansions: 获得：找着并归到自己手上
取得：经过努力拿到，如取得资格
学到：知识和习惯也这么一点点找来、留下

words.root_logic: space（撑开的距离，← spatium）+ craft（船、器）→ 开进天外那段空处去的船
words.origin: space（← 古法语 espace ← 拉丁语 spatium 跨开的距离）＋craft（船、飞行器，本义技艺，古英语 cræft）
words.native_definition: a vehicle built to travel beyond the earth's atmosphere
words.core_concept: a vessel for the open distance beyond the sky – 开进天外那段空处的船
words.core_image: 白色的舱体在没有空气的黑里滑行，窗外一颗星也不动
examples: The spacecraft reached Mars in seven months.
Engineers tested the spacecraft in a vacuum.
semantic_expansions: 航天器：能在大气层外飞行的器具
宇宙飞船：载人往来天外的那一种

words.root_logic: terr（吓住，← terrere）+ -fic（造成）→ 原意吓死人的 → 语气翻转，成了大得惊人、好得惊人
words.origin: 拉丁语 terrificus（引起惊惧的）← terrere（吓住）＋-ficus（造成…的）
words.native_definition: extremely good, or extremely great in degree
words.core_concept: so great that it once meant frightening – 大到当初是用来说吓人的
words.core_image: 散场后他一路说个不停，反复讲刚才那一段有多不得了
examples: We had a terrific time at the beach.
The car went at a terrific speed.
semantic_expansions: 极好的：好得让人吃惊，口语常用
了不起的：本事或表现远超一般
极大的：程度大得惊人，如速度惊人

words.origin: 古英语 trēg / trīg（浅边木盘）← 原始日耳曼语 *traujam（木制器皿），与 tree（树、木）同出一支
words.native_definition: a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic with a low rim, used for carrying things
words.core_concept: a flat board with a low rim for carrying – 一块平板，四边略翘，用来端东西
words.core_image: 一块平板四边翘起一指高，杯子和碗摆上去，端过走廊也不滑
examples: She carried the tray of cups upstairs.
Put the empty plates on the tray.
semantic_expansions: 托盘：端着走的那块平板
盘子：浅而平的一件器皿，同形的部件也这么叫
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ vict（战胜，← vincere）→ convincere：在庭上把对方的说法整个压过去 → 罪名就定下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 convictus（被证实有罪的）← convincere：com（彻底）＋vincere（战胜、压服）
words.native_definition: to decide officially in court that someone is guilty, or a person serving a sentence
words.core_concept: the other side's case fully overcome in court – 在庭上把对方的说法整个压过去
words.core_image: 法槌落下，被告的辩解一条条被驳倒，当天就换上囚服
examples: The jury convicted him of theft.
Two convicts escaped from the prison.
semantic_expansions: 定罪：法庭认定罪名成立
判定有罪：正式判下这个人有罪
囚犯：被这样判定、正在服刑的那个人

words.root_logic: at-/ad-（朝向）+ tent（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 把心力朝一处伸过去
words.origin: 拉丁语 attentio（专心）← attendere：ad（朝向）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: the act of directing your mind or eyes towards something
words.core_concept: the mind stretched out towards one thing – 把心力朝一处伸过去
words.core_image: 教室里所有人的头齐齐转向门口那个人，笔都停在纸上
examples: May I have your attention for a moment.
The child craves his mother's attention.
semantic_expansions: 注意：把心朝某处伸过去，别处就顾不上
注意力：能这么伸出去的那份心力，有多有少
关注：长期把这份心力搭在某件事上

words.root_logic: ex-（往外）+ tens（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 往外伸出去的那一截
words.origin: 拉丁语 extensio（伸展）← extendere：ex（往外）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: an added part that makes something longer or larger, or extra time granted
words.core_concept: the piece stretched out beyond the original – 从原来那截往外伸出去的部分
words.core_image: 桌子中间加进一块板，两头各多出一截，原先坐六人现在坐十人
examples: They built an extension at the back of the house.
He asked for an extension on the deadline.
semantic_expansions: 延伸部分：接在原物后面多出来的那一段
扩建：房子往外接出一块，占地变大
延期：时间也这么往外拉长一截
电话分机：总机往外接出去的那一条线

words.root_logic: ex-（往外）+ tent（伸，← tendere）→ 一样东西往外伸到哪里为止
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 extente（丈量、估值）← 古法语 estendre ← 拉丁语 extendere：ex（往外）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: how far something reaches, or how large or serious it is
words.core_concept: how far a thing stretches before it stops – 一样东西往外伸到哪里为止
words.core_image: 火烧过的地界用绳子围起来，人拿尺子量出从这头到那头有多远
examples: The extent of the damage is still unclear.
To some extent I agree with you.
semantic_expansions: 程度：一件事到了多深多重的那个刻度
范围：从这头伸到那头所圈住的那一片
广度：伸得开不开，摊得大不大

words.root_logic: in-（朝一点）+ tens（绷，← tendere）→ 力气全绷向一处，不散开
words.origin: 拉丁语 intensus（绷紧的）← intendere：in（朝向）＋tendere（伸展、绷紧）
words.native_definition: very strong or extreme in degree, or very serious and concentrated
words.core_concept: all the force pulled tight onto one point – 力气全绷向一点上
words.core_image: 阳光被放大镜收到一个小点上，纸面立刻冒起一缕烟
examples: She felt an intense pain in her side.
He gave the map an intense stare.
semantic_expansions: 强烈的：程度高到压过别的感觉
剧烈的：来势又猛又急，如疼得受不住
专注的：整个人绷向一件事，别的都不进眼

words.root_logic: in-（朝向）+ tent（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 心思先朝那个方向伸出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 intentio（用心、意向）← intendere：in（朝向）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: what you plan or mean to do
words.core_concept: the mind reaching toward a thing before the body moves – 身子没动，心思先朝那边伸过去
words.core_image: 他还没起身，眼睛已经盯住桌上那只杯子不放
examples: I have no intention of leaving early.
Her intentions were good from the start.
semantic_expansions: 意图：心里朝着的那个方向，还没做出来
打算：准备去做的那件事本身
用意：说这话做这事背后要达到的那点目的

words.root_logic: tens（绷紧，← tendere 伸展）→ 拉到不能再拉，一碰就弹
words.origin: 拉丁语 tensus（绷紧的，tendere 的过去分词）← tendere（伸展、拉紧）；表「时态」的 tense 另出拉丁语 tempus（时间），同形异源
words.native_definition: stretched tight, or nervous and unable to relax
words.core_concept: pulled tight, one touch away from snapping back – 拉到不能再拉，一碰就弹
words.core_image: 他坐在椅子边上，肩膀提着，手指扣住膝盖不松
examples: The rope was tense and hummed in the wind.
Everyone went tense when the phone rang.
semantic_expansions: 紧张的：人像被拉紧的绳，松不下来
绷紧的：说实物被拉得直挺挺，没有一丝松量

words.root_logic: tens（拉紧，← tendere）+ -ion → 两头对拉时中间那股劲
words.origin: 拉丁语 tensio（拉紧）← tendere（伸展、拉紧）
words.native_definition: the state of being stretched tight, or strained feeling between people
words.core_concept: the pull that builds when two ends draw apart – 两头往反方向拉时中间那股劲
words.core_image: 两人各拽住绳子一头往后退，绳子中段绷成一条直线，谁也不敢先松手
examples: Tension in the cable was measured hourly.
Tension between the two families grew.
semantic_expansions: 张力：物体被两头拉时内部那股力
紧张关系：人和人之间也这么互相拽着，随时会断
绷紧度：绳子或琴弦拉到多紧的那个量

words.root_logic: tent（撑开，← tendere 伸展）→ tenta：把布撑开绷住 → 撑开来住人的那件布屋
words.origin: 拉丁语 tenta（撑开的东西）← tendere（伸展、撑开）
words.native_definition: a shelter made of cloth stretched over poles
words.core_concept: cloth stretched over poles to live under – 把布撑开绷住，底下就能住人
words.core_image: 几根杆子支起来，布被拉开绷住，四角钉进土里就能睡人
examples: They pitched a tent by the river.
Rain drummed on the roof of the tent.

words.origin: 古法语 tendre ← 拉丁语 tener（软的、幼嫩的、年少的）；英语拼写里那个 -d- 是后来插进去的，与 tendere（伸展）不同词
words.native_definition: soft and easy to cut or chew, or gentle and full of care
words.core_concept: soft enough to yield at the lightest press – 软到轻轻一压就让开
words.core_image: 刀一压就断，肉在盘里散开，纤维不用嚼就化了
examples: The meat was tender and fell apart.
She gave him a tender look.
semantic_expansions: 嫩的：质地软，容易切开咬开
温柔的：待人的手法也这么轻，不硬来
一碰就疼的：皮肉发软发弱，一按就受不了
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: a-/ad-（朝向）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 把自己看到的摆到你眼前
words.origin: 古法语 aviser（细看、斟酌）← avis（看法）← 拉丁语 ad visum（照所见的）← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to tell someone what you think they should do
words.core_concept: setting what you have seen before another's eyes – 把自己看见的摆到别人眼前
words.core_image: 他把地图铺在桌上，手指点着其中一条路说走这边
examples: The doctor advised him to rest.
Please advise us of any change of address.
semantic_expansions: 建议：把你看到的路指给对方，让他自己走
劝告：对方要走错了，你出声拦一下
通知：正式把情况摆到对方眼前，让他知道

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ vid（看，← videre）→ 事先看出会缺什么，先备好摆出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 providere（预先看到、准备）：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: to give someone what they need, or to state something as a condition
words.core_concept: seeing ahead what will be wanted and putting it there – 先看出要缺什么，把它备在那里
words.core_image: 出发前他按人头把水和饼装进包，半路上果然一人拿到一份
examples: The school provides free meals.
The contract provides that either side may quit.
semantic_expansions: 提供：把对方需要的东西拿出来交到手上
供给：持续不断地送来所需的东西
规定：文书里预先看到的情形，写成一条摆在那儿

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ vis（看，← videre）+ -ion → 预先看出来、事先备下的那些东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 provisio（预见、预备）← providere：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: the act of supplying something, the supplies themselves, or a clause in an agreement
words.core_concept: what was seen ahead and laid in beforehand – 预先看出来、事先备下的那一份
words.core_image: 船舱里码着够吃三个月的箱子，旁边一纸文书写明谁能动它
examples: The provision of clean water is urgent.
One clause is a provision against late delivery.
semantic_expansions: 供应：把需要的东西预先备好送到
储备物资：备下的那批粮食器具本身
条款：文书里预先想到的情形，一条条写下来管着后事

words.root_logic: prud（← providens 预见的，缩合而来）+ -ent → 事情还没到就先看见，因而不冒进
words.origin: 拉丁语 prudens（明智的、慎重的），是 providens（预见的）的缩合形 ← providere：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: careful and sensible, avoiding needless risk
words.core_concept: seeing the thing coming before it arrives – 事情还没到就先看见
words.core_image: 过河前他用棍子往前探了三下，才敢把脚落下去
examples: It would be prudent to keep a copy.
She is a prudent manager of money.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎的：先看清再动，不给自己留险
精明的：把利害都先看到了，因而不吃亏

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 回头再看一遍，看出该改的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 revisere（再看、重访）← re（再）＋visere（细看）← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to look at something again in order to change or improve it, or to study again
words.core_concept: looking at a thing a second time and changing what shows – 回头再看一遍，看出要动的地方
words.core_image: 稿子放了一夜，第二天再看一遍，划掉三句，另添两句
examples: He revised the report before sending it.
She revises for the exam every evening.
semantic_expansions: 修改：再看一遍，把不合的地方改掉
修订：正式出一个改过的版本，如修订条文
复习：学过的东西回头再看一遍，让它留住

words.root_logic: super-（在上方）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 站在上头看着底下做
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 supervidere（在上察看）：super（在上）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: to watch over people or work to make sure it is done properly
words.core_concept: watching from above while the work goes on – 站在上头看着底下做
words.core_image: 他站在二层走廊往下望，车间里谁一停手他都看得见
examples: A teacher supervises the children at lunch.
She supervises three research students.
semantic_expansions: 监督：在旁看着，出错就叫停
主管：整摊事在你眼下，由你看着办

words.root_logic: mot（推动，← movere）+ -ive（能动的）+ -ate → 在人心里装上一股推力
words.origin: motive（← 中世纪拉丁语 motivus 能推动的 ← 拉丁语 movere 移动）＋-ate
words.native_definition: to make someone want to do something
words.core_concept: fitting an inner push into someone – 在人心里装上一股推力
words.core_image: 教练在他耳边说了一句，那人转身就冲上跑道
examples: Good pay motivates the staff.
What motivated him to leave?
semantic_expansions: 激励：从外面给一把劲，让人自己动起来
使有动力：心里有了那股推力，不用催也肯做

words.root_logic: pro-（往前）+ mot（推，← movere）→ 从后面往前推一把
words.origin: 拉丁语 promotus（被推向前的）← promovere：pro（往前）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to help something advance, to raise someone to a higher post, or to advertise
words.core_concept: pushing a thing forward from behind – 从后面往前推一把
words.core_image: 一只手在背后往前一送，人和事都往前挪了一格
examples: Exercise promotes good health.
She was promoted to head of sales.
semantic_expansions: 促进：给一把劲，让事情往前走得快些
晋升：把人往上一级推，位置比原先前
推销：把货往人前推，让它走出去

words.root_logic: re-（往回、离开）+ mot（挪，← movere）→ 被挪开到很远的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 remotus（被挪开的）← removere：re（离开）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: far away in space or time, distant in manner, or worked from a distance
words.core_concept: moved right away from where things are – 被挪到离一切都很远的地方
words.core_image: 从山口望下去，那几户人家小得像米粒，公路到半山就断了
examples: They live in a remote mountain village.
Use the remote control to switch it off.
semantic_expansions: 遥远的：距离或年代离得很开
偏僻的：挪出人烟之外，路都难通
冷淡的：待人也像挪开了一段，不肯靠近
遥控的：人在远处，手不碰机器也能让它动

words.root_logic: re-（离开）+ mov（挪，← movere）→ 把东西从原处挪走
words.origin: 古法语 removoir ← 拉丁语 removere：re（离开）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to take something away from where it is, or to dismiss someone from a post
words.core_concept: shifting a thing off the place it sat – 把东西从它待的地方挪开
words.core_image: 工人把堵在门口的箱子一只只搬到院外，门口空出来了
examples: Remove the pan from the heat.
He was removed from office last week.
semantic_expansions: 移开：把东西从原来位置挪到别处
去掉：连东西本身也不留，如去掉污点
免职：把人从那个位置上挪下来

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ in-（落到上头）+ cid（落下，← cadere）→ 两件事落到同一个点上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 coincidere：com（一同）＋incidere（落到某处上头）← in（上）＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: to happen at the same time, or to be the same or agree exactly
words.core_concept: two things falling onto the very same point – 两件东西落到同一个点上
words.core_image: 两张透明纸叠在一起，上面那个圆圈的边线正压住下面那个
examples: Her visit coincided with the storm.
Our views coincide on most points.
semantic_expansions: 同时发生：两件事的时间落在同一处
相符：两方的说法落到一处，对得上
重叠：两块范围落在一起，边界压住边界

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cid（切，← caedere）→ 一刀把纠缠的那头砍断，事情就定了
words.origin: 拉丁语 decidere（字面「砍掉」，引申为裁定）：de（去掉）＋caedere（切、砍）；与 cadere（落下）那支同形而不同源
words.native_definition: to choose one thing after thinking, or to settle a question
words.core_concept: cutting the tangle so one way is left – 一刀砍断纠缠，只留下一条
words.core_image: 两条路摊在眼前，他抬手一挥，另一条从此不再提
examples: She decided to take the job.
The judge decided the case in an hour.
semantic_expansions: 决定：几个选项里砍掉别的，留一个
裁决：由有权的人一刀切开双方的争执
解决：把缠住不动的那一处砍开，事情能往下走

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cis（切，← caedere）+ -ion → 砍断之后留下的那一条
words.origin: 拉丁语 decisio（裁断、了结）← decidere：de（去掉）＋caedere（切、砍）
words.native_definition: a choice or judgement that has been made, or the ability to make one firmly
words.core_concept: the one line left after the rest are cut away – 砍掉其余之后留下的那一条
words.core_image: 会开到最后，主持人在纸上划掉两行，只留一行，起身散会
examples: They reached a decision after long talks.
He acted with speed and decision.
semantic_expansions: 决定：定下来的那个选择本身
判决：法庭切开争执后给出的那个结果
果断：下手砍得快，不在几条之间来回磨

words.root_logic: af-/ad-（朝向）+ fect（做，← facere）+ -ion → 那个人在你心里做出了一道印子
words.origin: 拉丁语 affectio（心里被触动而生的状态）← afficere：ad（朝向）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: a gentle feeling of liking or love for someone
words.core_concept: the mark another person works into your heart – 那个人在你心里做出的一道印子
words.core_image: 老人每天给那只跛脚的猫留半碗饭，猫一见他就来蹭裤腿
examples: She has a deep affection for her students.
He wrote of his affection in every letter.
semantic_expansions: 喜爱：心里对某人某物长出的那份暖意
情感：被触动后留下的那一类心绪
爱慕：这份心意偏向一个人，还带着仰望

words.root_logic: fashion（样式，← façon ← factio「做出来的样子」← facere 做）+ -able → 眼下大家都照着做的那副样子
words.origin: fashion（← 古法语 façon 样式、做法 ← 拉丁语 factio 做出来的样子 ← facere 做）＋-able
words.native_definition: following the style that is popular at the moment
words.core_concept: cut to the shape everyone is making just now – 眼下人人都照着做的那副样子
words.core_image: 街上一半人穿着同一种剪裁的外套，去年那款没人再拿出来
examples: Short coats are fashionable this winter.
They live in a fashionable part of town.
semantic_expansions: 时髦的：跟着当下的样式走，看着新
流行的：这副样子正被许多人同时照做
上流的：讲究这套样式的那一圈人和地方

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ fect（做，← facere）+ -ion → 一路做到底，再没有一处可添可减
words.origin: 拉丁语 perfectio（做成、完满）← perficere：per（彻底）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: the state of being as good as it can possibly be
words.core_concept: worked all the way through, nothing left to add or take – 做到底了，添一点减一点都不行
words.core_image: 木工磨完最后一道边，指腹从头摸到尾，没有一处硌手
examples: The dish was cooked to perfection.
She strives for perfection in her work.
semantic_expansions: 完美：好到再挑不出可改的地方
完善：把余下的缺口一个个做齐
精通：同一件事做到底，手上再无生涩

words.root_logic: de-（明确地）+ not（做记号，← notare）→ 用一个记号把那样东西指出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 denotare（标明、指出）：de（明确地）＋notare（做记号）← nota（记号）
words.native_definition: to be a sign of something, or to stand for it
words.core_concept: a mark set down to point at one thing – 用一个记号把某样东西点出来
words.core_image: 地图上一个小三角压在等高线中间，旁边写着这里最高
examples: A red light denotes danger.
In maths, x denotes the unknown.
semantic_expansions: 表示：用符号或说法把某样东西摆明
指代：这个记号就替那样东西站在那里
意味着：见到这个记号，就知道背后是什么

words.root_logic: nota（记号）→ 在纸上或心里留一个记号，事后照着它把整件事想回来
words.origin: 拉丁语 nota（记号、字符、标记）
words.native_definition: a short record in writing, a musical sign, or to notice something
words.core_concept: a small mark left so the whole comes back later – 留一个小记号，回头凭它把整件事想回来
words.core_image: 听讲时他在纸角划下几个字，散会后照着那几个字把整段话想起来
examples: I made a note of the address.
Note the change in his voice.
semantic_expansions: 笔记：为记住而随手留下的那些字
便条：写给别人的短短一张，摆在他能看见处
音符：谱面上一个记号，指明该出哪个音
注意到：在心里给某处划上一道，不让它滑过去

words.root_logic: note（记号、记录，← notare）+ book（本子）→ 专供留记号用的那个本子
words.origin: note（← 拉丁语 nota 记号）＋book（本子）
words.native_definition: a book of blank pages for writing things down, or a small portable computer
words.core_concept: the book kept for setting marks down in – 专门用来留下记号的那个本子
words.core_image: 一本用橡皮筋箍着的册子，每页写满字，边角都卷了起来
examples: She wrote the number in her notebook.
He carries a thin notebook to meetings.
semantic_expansions: 笔记本：一页页留字用的空白本子
记事簿：专记事项和日程的那一种
笔记本电脑：外形像那个本子、合起来能带走的电脑

words.root_logic: contro-（对着）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ial → 两边各自转过身来对着对方，谁也不让
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 controversialis ← controversia（争论）← controversus（转过来对着的）：contra（对着）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: causing a lot of public disagreement
words.core_concept: each side turned to face the other, neither giving way – 两边转过身对着对方，谁也不退
words.core_image: 一张桌子两边的人同时举手，都要先说，主持人敲了三下压不住
examples: The new tax is highly controversial.
He made a controversial remark on air.
semantic_expansions: 有争议的：一说出来就有人站对面反对
引起争论的：本身像个开关，一碰就把两边引到对立处

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ion → 整个翻过来，成了另一副样子
words.origin: 拉丁语 conversio（转变）← convertere：com（彻底）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: a change from one form, use or belief to another
words.core_concept: turned all the way over into another form – 整个翻过来，换成另一副样子
words.core_image: 旧仓库拆了隔墙装上窗，人再进去已看不出它原先做什么用
examples: The conversion of the barn took a year.
He spoke about his conversion to Islam.
semantic_expansions: 转变：从一种形态整个转成另一种
改建：房屋换个用途，里外重做
换算：把一种单位翻成另一种，量还是那个量
皈依：信从一边转到另一边

words.root_logic: di-/dis-（岔开）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ion → 从原来那条路上转开，岔到别处
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 diversio（转开）← divertere：dis（岔开）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: the act of turning something aside, a different route, or something that entertains
words.core_concept: turned off the line it was running on – 从原本那条线上转开，走到别处去
words.core_image: 路口立起牌子，车流被引进旁边一条小道，主路空着在铺沥青
examples: The fire was a diversion to draw the guards away.
Follow the diversion around the bridge.
semantic_expansions: 转移：把注意力或资源从这边引到那边
临时绕道：主路不通时给车走的那条旁路
消遣：心思从正事上转开一会儿，找点乐子

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ pro-（往前）+ duc（引，← ducere）→ 把同一样东西再引出来一遍
words.origin: re-（再）＋produce（← 拉丁语 producere：pro 往前＋ducere 引导）
words.native_definition: to make a copy of something, or to produce young
words.core_concept: drawing the same thing forth one more time – 把同一样东西再引出来一次
words.core_image: 版子往纸上一压再抬起，纸上又是同一幅图，连墨点都落在原处
examples: The picture is hard to reproduce in black and white.
Most fish reproduce by laying eggs.
semantic_expansions: 复制：照原样再引出一份，两份分不出
再现：把当时的情形原样引出来给人看
繁殖：生物把自己这一样再引出一代

words.root_logic: semi-（半）+ con-（一路）+ duct（引，← ducere）+ -or → 只肯半路引电过去的那种材料
words.origin: semi-（半）＋conductor（← 拉丁语 conductor 领路者、传导者 ← conducere：com 一起＋ducere 引导）
words.native_definition: a material that conducts electricity only under certain conditions
words.core_concept: a stuff that leads current only halfway – 只肯半路引电过去的那种料
words.core_image: 一小片灰亮的方块，通了电有时让它过去，有时又挡住，全看条件
examples: Silicon is the most common semiconductor.
The factory makes semiconductor chips.

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ leg（拣选、择取，← legere）+ -ium → 一批人被挑到一处共事，成了那个团体
words.origin: 拉丁语 collegium（同僚的团体）← collega（共事的同僚）：com（一起）＋leg-（legare 择取、委派的词干），与 legere（拣选）同出一支
words.native_definition: a place of higher education, or an organized body of people with shared duties
words.core_concept: a set of people picked out to sit together – 被挑到一处共事的那一批人
words.core_image: 同一批被挑进来的人住在一个院子里，一起上课、一起吃饭、一起管院里的事
examples: She teaches at a small college in the north.
The college of cardinals met in Rome.
semantic_expansions: 学院：把学生挑进来集中教的那一处
大学：北美常拿它泛指本科阶段的学校
团体：因同一职分被挑到一起的那批人，如枢机团

words.root_logic: leg（读，← legere）+ -enda（该被…的）→ 该拿出来念给众人听的那些篇章
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 legenda（该读的东西，legere 的动形词中性复数）← 拉丁语 legere（拾取、挑选、读）；与 lex（法条）那支同出更早词根而各成一路
words.native_definition: an old story handed down, a very famous person, or the key to a map
words.core_concept: the passages read aloud year after year – 一年年被念给众人听的那些篇章
words.core_image: 修院饭厅里每天有人站着念一段旧事，念了几百年，听的人都当真
examples: Every village has its own legend.
He became a legend in his own lifetime.
semantic_expansions: 传说：口口相传、越传越远的旧事
传奇人物：名字被人反复讲起，像故事一样
图例：地图角上那一小块，专供人读符号的意思

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ oper（劳作，← operari）+ -ate → 几方的力气搭到同一件活上
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 cooperari（共同劳作）：com（一起）＋operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: to work together with someone towards the same result
words.core_concept: several hands set to the very same job – 几方的力气搭到同一件活上
words.core_image: 四个人抬一根梁，谁也不敢先松手，脚步得一起迈
examples: The two firms cooperate on research.
He refused to cooperate with the police.
semantic_expansions: 合作：两方各出力气办同一件事
协作：分工不同却对着同一个结果使劲
配合：顺着对方的动作出力，不添乱

words.root_logic: oper（劳作、运转，← operari）+ -ator（做这事的人）→ 让机器或生意转起来的那个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 operator（劳作者）← operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: a person who runs a machine or a business
words.core_concept: the one who keeps the thing running – 让那台东西或那门生意转起来的人
words.core_image: 控制台前的人手不离手柄，屏幕上的数字全跟着他的动作变
examples: The crane operator waved us back.
A local operator runs the bus route.
semantic_expansions: 操作员：亲手开机器的那个人
接线员：早年在总机前替人接通电话的人
经营者：把一门生意撑着转下去的一方

words.root_logic: post-（在后）+ pon（放，← ponere）→ 把这件事从眼前拿起来，放到后面去
words.origin: 拉丁语 postponere（置于其后）：post（在后）＋ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to move an event to a later time
words.core_concept: taking a thing out of now and setting it further back – 把它从眼前拿走，放到后头去
words.core_image: 日历上原先圈好的那一格被划掉，圈重新画在下一周
examples: They postponed the match because of rain.
Let us postpone the decision until Friday.
semantic_expansions: 推迟：把原定的时间往后挪
延后：整件事的次序也跟着往后排

words.root_logic: pur-/por-（往前）+ pose（放，承 ponere 的义）→ 把要达成的那件事放到自己前头
words.origin: 古法语 porpos（意图）← porposer（往前放、提出）：por-（往前，← 拉丁语 pro）＋poser（放置）；法语 poser 形出晚期拉丁语 pausare（放下、停下），其义与形都并入了拉丁语 ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the reason for which something is done or made
words.core_concept: the thing you set out in front of yourself – 放在自己前头、一路朝着走的那件事
words.core_image: 出门前他把要办成的那件事写在手心，路上别的都能放下，这一件不能
examples: What is the purpose of this meeting?
The room serves no useful purpose now.
semantic_expansions: 目的：做一件事所朝着的那个结果
意图：心里放在前头、还没说出的打算
用途：一件东西被放在那儿是要它派什么用

words.root_logic: aequi（相等，← aequus 两边一样平）+ valent（值、有力，← valere）→ 两边称出来的分量一样平
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 aequivalens（价值相等的）← aequivalere：aequus（平的、相等的）＋valere（值、有力）
words.native_definition: equal in value, amount or meaning, or a thing that is equal to another
words.core_concept: both sides weighing out the same – 两边称出来的分量一样平
words.core_image: 天平一端放着金块，另一端堆着碎银，指针停在正中不偏
examples: Ten miles is roughly equivalent to sixteen kilometres.
There is no exact equivalent in Chinese.
semantic_expansions: 相等的：两样东西的量或值一样
等价物：另一边那件顶得上它的东西
相当于：换算过来正好抵上那么多

words.root_logic: artus（关节、接合处，与 ars 同源）+ -culus（小）→ articulus：一个小关节 → 整体上被分开的一小节
words.origin: 古法语 article ← 拉丁语 articulus（小关节、分节）← artus（关节、接合），与 ars（手上的门道）同出一支
words.native_definition: a piece of writing, a separate clause, a single item, or a grammar word like "the"
words.core_concept: one joint in a thing that is divided into joints – 整体被分成一节节，其中的一节
words.core_image: 一份文件被横线切成一条条，每条自成一段，能单独指着说就是这一条
examples: She wrote an article about city birds.
Article five of the treaty covers this.
semantic_expansions: 文章：报刊上自成一节的那一篇
条款：合约或法规里单独成立的一条
物品：清单上一件件分开数的东西
冠词：名词前那个小小的一节，如 the

words.root_logic: ec-/ex-（出来）+ centr（圆心，← centrum）+ -ic → 圆心跑出了它该在的位置
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 eccentricus ← 希腊语 ekkentros：ek（出）＋kentron（圆规的尖脚、圆心）
words.native_definition: behaving in a strange way, or not having the same centre
words.core_concept: the middle point sitting off where it belongs – 中点不在它该在的位置上
words.core_image: 两个圆套在一起，里面那个的中点偏出去一截，一转就一边宽一边窄
examples: Her eccentric neighbour paints at night.
The wheel runs on an eccentric shaft.
semantic_expansions: 古怪的：言行不落在常人那个中点上
离心的：机械里中心特意偏开，转起来产生往外的甩劲

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ clar（明亮、清楚，← clarus）+ -ation → 把话摆到亮处，人人都看得清
words.origin: 拉丁语 declaratio（说明、宣告）← declarare：de（彻底）＋clarare（使明亮）← clarus（明亮、清楚）
words.native_definition: an official or formal statement made in public
words.core_concept: words put where the light falls on them – 把话摆到亮处，谁都看得清
words.core_image: 一张纸贴在城门口，字大得站远也认得出，末尾落着印和日期
examples: The declaration was read out at noon.
You must sign a customs declaration.
semantic_expansions: 宣告：正式把一件事当众说明
声明：把自己的立场摆明，不留含糊
申报：向官方把该讲的情况一条条写清

words.root_logic: en-/in-（使…）+ dur（硬，← durus）→ 硬着不软，一直撑在那里
words.origin: 古法语 endurer ← 拉丁语 indurare（使变硬）：in（使）＋durus（硬的）；表「持续」的 durare 同出此源
words.native_definition: to bear something painful for a long time, or to last
words.core_concept: going hard and not giving way – 硬着不软，撑在那里不动
words.core_image: 他背着麻袋走了三十里，肩上压出两道红痕也没把袋子放下
examples: She endured years of pain without complaint.
Their friendship endured for fifty years.
semantic_expansions: 忍受：难受的事压在身上也不放手
持续：东西也这么硬撑着，多少年都还在

words.root_logic: flu（流，← fluere）+ -idus（有…性质的）→ 会自己往低处淌、不定形状的那种东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 fluidus（会流动的）← fluere（流动）
words.native_definition: a substance that flows, such as a liquid or gas, or moving smoothly and easily
words.core_concept: stuff with no shape of its own, always running downhill – 自己不定形状，总顺着低处淌
words.core_image: 倒进方杯是方的，倒进圆杯是圆的，杯子一斜就顺着壁往下走
examples: Drink plenty of fluids in hot weather.
Her movements were smooth and fluid.
semantic_expansions: 液体：能倒能流的那类东西
流体：物理上把液体和气体一并这么叫
流畅的：动作或线条像水那样接得上，不打顿

words.root_logic: ob-（对着、挡在前）+ ject（投，← jacere）+ -ion → 把话像石头一样扔到对方跟前挡住他
words.origin: 拉丁语 obiectio（挡在前、抗辩）← obicere：ob（对着）＋jacere（投、扔）
words.native_definition: a statement that you disagree with something, or the reason you give
words.core_concept: words thrown down in the other's path – 把话扔到对方跟前，挡住他往下走
words.core_image: 他话还没说完，对面站起一个人，把手里那张纸往桌上一摔
examples: She raised no objection to the plan.
My main objection is the cost.
semantic_expansions: 反对：明确站出来不同意
异议：与多数不同的那个说法本身
反对的理由：扔出去挡路的那块石头是什么

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ com-（一起）+ mod（量度、尺寸，← modus）+ -ate → 按对方的尺寸把自己这边配上去
words.origin: 拉丁语 accommodatus（配得合适的）← accommodare：ad（朝向）＋commodus（合尺寸的）← com（一起）＋modus（量度、尺寸）
words.native_definition: to provide room or lodging for someone, or to fit in with their needs
words.core_concept: sizing your side to fit the other's measure – 按对方的尺寸把自己这边配上
words.core_image: 客人多来了两位，主人搬来两把椅子，桌子往外挪半尺，正好都坐下
examples: The hall can accommodate three hundred people.
We tried to accommodate his wishes.
semantic_expansions: 容纳：地方或器物装得下那么多
提供住处：把人安顿进屋里，给他一处睡
迁就：把自己的安排改一改，凑对方的尺寸

words.root_logic: pro-（当众、往前）+ nunci（报信，← nuntiare）+ -ation → 把字音像一则消息那样送到人耳前
words.origin: 古法语 prononciation ← 拉丁语 pronuntiatio（宣读、念出声）← pronuntiare：pro（当众）＋nuntiare（通告）← nuntius（信使）
words.native_definition: the way a word is said, or the act of saying words
words.core_concept: sending the sound of a word out to another's ear – 把字音像消息一样送到人耳前
words.core_image: 老师把同一个字念了三遍，嘴张多大、舌头搁哪儿都做给底下人看
examples: His English pronunciation has improved.
The two words share one pronunciation.
semantic_expansions: 发音：把音说出口这件事，也指说出来的效果
读法：某个字该怎么念的那一套定法

words.root_logic: physio（天然的本性与运作，← physis）+ -logia（…之学）+ -al → 讲这具身子本来怎么运转的那一门
words.origin: physiology（← 希腊语 physiologia：physis 自然、本性＋-logia …之学）＋-al
words.native_definition: relating to the way living bodies work
words.core_concept: about how a living body works of itself – 关于这具身子自己怎么运转
words.core_image: 医生指着挂图讲，心跳、出汗、饿了想吃，都是这具身子自己在按规矩办事
examples: Fear causes real physiological changes.
She studies physiological responses to cold.
semantic_expansions: 生理的：与身体天然的运作有关，不涉心理
生理学的：属于研究这套运作的那门学问

words.root_logic: pro-（在众人前）+ fess（承认、说出，← profiteri）+ -ion + -al → 当众认下这门本事，从此以它为业
words.origin: profession（← 拉丁语 professio 当众声明、所认下的名分 ← profiteri：pro 在众人前＋fateri 承认）＋-al
words.native_definition: relating to a paid occupation that needs training, or a person who does it
words.core_concept: standing on a skill you have owned out loud – 当众认下的那门本事，靠它立身
words.core_image: 他把执照挂在墙上，收钱只做这一件事，做坏了得自己担着
examples: She wants professional advice on the contract.
He turned professional at nineteen.
semantic_expansions: 专业的：手上这门本事是练过的，做得出规矩
职业的：以此为生，与业余相对
