专业人士：靠这门本事挣饭吃的那个人

words.root_logic: sci（知道、分得清，← scire）+ -entia（所知）+ -ficus（造成…的）→ 造出确知的东西，不是随口说的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 scientificus（属于学问的）← scientia（所知、学问）＋-ficus（造成…的）← scire（知道、分辨）
words.native_definition: relating to science, or done in a careful and systematic way
words.core_concept: making what is truly known, not what is merely said – 造出确知的东西，而不是随口说的
words.core_image: 同一个实验换三个人做，记下的数字对得上，才敢把结论写下来
examples: The claim has no scientific basis.
He takes a scientific approach to training.
semantic_expansions: 科学的：属于用实验和证据立起来的那套学问
严谨的：做法一步步可查，换人来做也一样

words.root_logic: de-（去掉、反向）+ sper（盼望，← sperare）+ -ate → 心里那份盼望被抽走，只剩豁出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 desperatus（丧了希望的）← desperare：de（去掉）＋sperare（盼望）
words.native_definition: feeling hopeless, or ready to do anything because of great need
words.core_concept: the hope pulled out, only the last try left – 盼望被抽走，只剩最后一搏
words.core_image: 水已经涨到胸口，他把最后一块板往前一推，闭上眼跳了下去
examples: He gave a desperate cry for help.
She is desperate for a job.
semantic_expansions: 绝望的：看不见还能盼的东西
拼命的：正因没得盼，什么险都敢冒
极想要的：缺到心里发慌，非弄到不行

words.root_logic: testi（见证人，← testis）+ -monium（表事物的后缀）→ 见证人当众说出来的那番话
words.origin: 拉丁语 testimonium（证词、见证）← testis（见证人）
words.native_definition: a formal statement of what someone saw or knows, or clear proof of something
words.core_concept: the words a witness says out in the open – 见证人当众说出来的那番话
words.core_image: 台前那人举手说完一段，书记员一字一句记下，纸上按了指印
examples: His testimony sent two men to prison.
The old bridge is testimony to their skill.
semantic_expansions: 证词：在法庭上正式说出的所见所知
证明：一样东西本身摆在那里替谁作证

words.root_logic: tribus（罗马最初划分出的一支人，与 tribuere 分派同源）→ 从整体里分出来、自成一支的那群人
words.origin: 拉丁语 tribus（部族、罗马人最初划分的一支），与 tribuere（分配、分派）同出一支
words.native_definition: a group of people of the same descent and customs, living under a leader
words.core_concept: one branch divided off from the whole people – 从整体里分出来、自成一支的那群人
words.core_image: 河谷里几百口人讲同一种话、认同一个长者，隔山那边是另外一伙
examples: The tribe moved south each winter.
Twelve tribes shared the same language.
semantic_expansions: 部落：靠血缘和习俗聚在一处、有首领的一群
部族：同一祖源分出的那一支，规模更大
族群：泛指分得出来的一群人，如各族群共处

words.root_logic: pro-（往前、朝外）+ vok（叫，← vocare）→ 冲着人喊，把他心里的反应叫出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 provocare（唤出、挑动）：pro（往前）＋vocare（呼叫）← vox（声音）
words.native_definition: to cause a reaction, or to make someone angry on purpose
words.core_concept: calling a reaction out of someone – 冲着人喊，把他的反应叫出来
words.core_image: 他一句接一句冲着对面喊，那人本来坐着，最后拍桌站了起来
examples: The remark provoked laughter in the hall.
Do not provoke the dog.
semantic_expansions: 激起：把某种反应从人身上引出来
挑动：有意去撩，让局面动起来
惹怒：叫出来的那个反应是火气

words.root_logic: ad-（朝、到）+ vent（来）→ 一件大事朝这边过来，已经到了眼前
words.origin: 拉丁语 adventus（到来）← advenire：ad-（朝向）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the arrival of an important person, thing, or period
words.core_concept: something important coming into view – 要紧的东西朝这边来了
words.core_image: 站台上的人都朝同一头张望，远处车头的灯已经能看见
examples: The advent of the internet changed everything.
People waited for the advent of spring.
semantic_expansions: 到来：一件大事走到眼前的那一刻
出现：原先没有的东西开始存在于世上

words.root_logic: ad-（朝）+ vent（来）+ -ure → 迎面撞上来的事，事先谁也说不准是什么
words.origin: 古法语 aventure ← 通俗拉丁语 *adventura（将要到来的事）← 拉丁语 advenire：ad-（朝向）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: an exciting or risky experience
words.core_concept: walking into whatever comes at you – 迎面来什么全然不知地走进去
words.core_image: 两个人背着包走进没画在图上的岔路，路口连块牌子也没有
examples: They set off on an adventure in the mountains.
Her trip across Asia was a real adventure.
semantic_expansions: 冒险：明知说不准会碰上什么，还是往里走
奇遇：路上撞上来的一段稀罕经历

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ ven（来）+ -ience → 需要的几样正好凑到一处来
words.origin: 拉丁语 convenientia（相合、适宜）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the quality of being easy to use or well suited to your needs
words.core_concept: things coming together right where you need them – 要用的东西正好都凑到手边
words.core_image: 楼下拐角就有一家小店，深夜下楼两分钟能买到牙刷
examples: We chose the flat for its convenience.
The hotel has every modern convenience.
semantic_expansions: 方便：省时省力，用起来不费事
便利：条件都凑齐了，办事顺当
便利设施：为省事专门备下的那些东西

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ vent（来）+ -ion → 众人聚到一处，以及聚起来定下的那套东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 conventio（集会、约定）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: a large formal meeting, or an accepted way of doing things
words.core_concept: coming together, and what the gathering settles on – 聚到一处，以及聚起来定下的东西
words.core_image: 几百人从各地赶到同一个场馆，散场时手里都拿着同一份签好的文本
examples: She spoke at the party's annual convention.
By convention, the host pays the bill.
semantic_expansions: 大会：众人从各处聚到同一场合
惯例：大家心里都认、不必再商量的那套做法
公约：多方聚拢后正式签下的那份约定

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ vent（来）+ -ional → 众人聚起来认下的那一套，照它来的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 conventionalis ← 拉丁语 conventio（约定、成例）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: following what most people usually do
words.core_concept: going the way the gathering agreed on – 按众人聚起来定下的那套走
words.core_image: 一屋子人都穿深色西装，后进门的也解开外套换了同色的一身
examples: They had a conventional wedding in the village church.
He uses conventional methods only.
semantic_expansions: 传统的：跟着一直以来的那一套做
常规的：属于多数场合的通常做法
因循的：只肯照旧，不肯出格

words.root_logic: inter-（在中间）+ vene（来）→ 从两者中间插进来
words.origin: 拉丁语 intervenire：inter-（在中间）＋venire（来）——'走到中间来'
words.native_definition: to come between people or events in order to change what happens
words.core_concept: stepping in between – 走到两者当中去
words.core_image: 两人在街上推搡起来，第三个人挤进当中，两只手各挡一边
examples: The police had to intervene in the fight.
She intervened to stop the argument.
semantic_expansions: 干预：外人插手，把事情的走向改掉
调停：站在两边中间劝和
介入：本不相干的一方进到事里来

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ venue（来）→ 投出去以后又转回到手里的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 revenue（返回、收益）← revenir ← 拉丁语 revenire：re-（回）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the money that a business or a government takes in
words.core_concept: what comes back in – 转回到手里的那一份
words.core_image: 月底把柜台钱箱倒空，一张张点过，比进货那天出去的厚了一层
examples: The shop's revenue rose by ten percent.
Tax revenue fell sharply last year.
semantic_expansions: 收入：一段时间里进到账上的钱
税收：政府按法收进来的那部分
收益：一桩生意转回来的钱数

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cess（行走）→ 走到跟前去 → 进得去、够得着
words.origin: 拉丁语 accessus（走近、入口）← accedere：ad-（朝向）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: the right or means of getting to something, or to get at it
words.core_concept: being able to walk up to a thing – 能走到它跟前
words.core_image: 门卫核过卡，闸机开了一条缝，他侧身进了只有少数人能进的那层楼
examples: The building has access for wheelchairs.
She could not access her own account.
semantic_expansions: 通道：能走进去的那条路或那个口子
使用权：许你去用、去看的那份资格
查阅：到库里把要的那条取出来看

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ cess（行走）→ 走到界线外头的那一部分
words.origin: 拉丁语 excessus（越出）← excedere：ex-（出）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: an amount that is more than what is needed or allowed
words.core_concept: what has walked past the line – 越过线那一头的部分
words.core_image: 米倒进量杯，高过刻度线的那些顺着杯口淌到桌面上
examples: He drank to excess at the party.
You must pay for excess baggage.
semantic_expansions: 过量：多到超出该有的限度
超出部分：越过定额之外多出来的那些

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ cess（行走）+ -ive → 已经走过界的
words.origin: 古法语 excessif ← 中世纪拉丁语 excessivus ← 拉丁语 excedere：ex-（出）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: much more than is reasonable or necessary
words.core_concept: gone well past where the line was – 早已走过那条线
words.core_image: 一整勺盐倒进汤锅，尝一口齁得咽不下去
examples: The noise from the bar was excessive.
She spends an excessive amount on clothes.
semantic_expansions: 过分的：超出常理能接受的那个度
过度的：量上多得压过了该有的分寸

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开、退走）+ -ary → 退不开、绕不过去的
words.origin: 拉丁语 necessarius（避不开的、不可少的）← necesse，一般析为 ne-（不）＋cedere（让开、退走）
words.native_definition: needed in order for something to happen or be done
words.core_concept: what will not step out of the way – 让不开也躲不过的那一样
words.core_image: 出门前摸口袋，钥匙不在就只能折回去拿，别的都可以不带
examples: Sleep is necessary for good health.
Take only what is necessary for the trip.
semantic_expansions: 必要的：少了它这件事就办不成
必需的：非得有，找不出东西替它

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开）+ -itate → 把局面逼到没有别条路可让
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 necessitare（使成为不可免）← 拉丁语 necessitas（避不开的处境）← necesse：ne-（不）＋cedere（让开）
words.native_definition: to make something necessary or unavoidable
words.core_concept: leaving no way to step aside – 把别的路都堵上，只剩这一条
words.core_image: 桥断了，所有车只剩绕山那一条路能走
examples: The heavy rain necessitated a change of plan.
His illness necessitated a long rest.
semantic_expansions: 使成为必需：让某件事从此非做不可
迫使：形势逼着人只能这么办

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开）+ -ity → 退不开的那种处境，也指退不开非要的东西
words.origin: 古法语 necessite ← 拉丁语 necessitas（避不开）← necesse：ne-（不）＋cedere（让开、退走）
words.native_definition: something you must have, or the state of being unavoidable
words.core_concept: the thing you cannot do without – 缺了就过不去的那一样
words.core_image: 逃难的包里最后只剩三样，水、药、一件外套
examples: Water is a basic necessity of life.
There is no necessity to hurry.
semantic_expansions: 必需品：日子过下去缺不了的那些东西
必要性：一件事到了非做不可的那种程度

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ minister（居下承事的人，← minus 更小）+ -ation → 一批人在下面把事务承起来办
words.origin: 拉丁语 administratio（执行、经管）← administrare：ad-（朝向）＋ministrare（服事）← minister（仆从）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: the work of running an organization, or the people who run it
words.core_concept: the below-stairs work of running a thing – 在下位把一摊事务承起来办
words.core_image: 一排桌子上摊着表格和印章，盖完的往左边推，没盖的还堆在右手边
examples: The company improved its administration of funds.
She works in hospital administration.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把一摊事务照章办下来
行政：机构日常的那些事务与手续
政府：在上位者之下具体执政的那一班人

words.origin: 意大利语 miniatura（手抄本上的小幅插画）← miniare（用红铅上色）← 拉丁语 minium（红铅）；'小'这一义出自插画本身细小，后又受 minor / minimus 一类 min- 词牵引，与 minus（更小）并非同源
words.native_definition: a very small copy or model of something
words.core_concept: a thing made small enough to sit in the palm – 缩到能托在掌心的一件东西
words.core_image: 火柴盒大小的一把椅子，扶手上的雕花要凑到眼前才看得清
examples: He collects miniature trains.
She painted a miniature of her mother.
semantic_expansions: 微型的：按原物缩小许多倍做出来的
小模型：照原样缩小的那件复制品
小画像：手掌大小的一幅人像，源出手抄本上的细画
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: minimus（最小，minus 一支的最高级）→ 一列量里最靠下的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 minimum（最少量）← minimus（最小的），与 minus / minor 同为一支的比较级形
words.native_definition: the smallest amount or level that is possible or allowed
words.core_concept: the lowest point of a range – 一列量里最靠下的那一点
words.core_image: 水表上那条红线画在最下面，水位再落就抽不上来了
examples: We need a minimum of ten people.
The minimum wage went up in April.
semantic_expansions: 最小值：一组数里最靠下的那一个
最低限度：再低就不许或办不成的那条线

words.root_logic: minister（居下承事的人，← minus 更小）+ -y → 承事者所司的那一摊，或他们合成的那个机构
words.origin: 古法语 menistere ← 拉丁语 ministerium（职事、服事）← minister（仆从）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: a government department, or the work of a member of the clergy
words.core_concept: the office of those who serve under – 居下承事者所司的那一摊
words.core_image: 楼门口挂一块铜牌，进出的人都夹着盖了同一个章的文件
examples: He works at the Ministry of Education.
She entered the ministry at thirty.
semantic_expansions: 部：政府里分管一摊事务的那一级机构
牧师职务：在教会里服事众人的那份职分

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ put（点算）+ -er → 替人把各项合起来算的那件东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 computare（合算）：com-（一起）＋putare（清点、估算）；-er 表施事，17 世纪先指'做计算的人'
words.native_definition: an electronic machine that stores information and works on it
words.core_concept: the thing that reckons it all up for you – 替你把各项合起来算清的那件东西
words.core_image: 桌上一个方盒子嗡嗡响着，屏幕上的数字一秒钟跳过几百遍
examples: She bought a new computer for work.
The computer stores all our records.
semantic_expansions: 计算机：按指令处理数据的那台机器
电脑：同一样东西的日常叫法，多指桌上那台

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ put（点算）→ computare 经古法语 conter（数）→ 点数收钱的那张台子，也指替人点数的那件东西
words.origin: 古法语 conteor（算桌）← 中世纪拉丁语 computatorium（记账处）← 拉丁语 computare：com-＋putare（清点）
words.native_definition: a long flat surface where you are served, or a device that counts
words.core_concept: where things get tallied up – 把数目点清的那张台子或那件东西
words.core_image: 一张长台横在店里，客人把钱放上去，店主在这一侧一枚枚数过
examples: She waited at the counter to pay.
The counter showed three thousand steps.
semantic_expansions: 柜台：店里数钱交货的那张长台
计数器：把次数一件件自动累上去的那件装置

words.origin: 中古英语 putten / puten（推、放）← 古英语 putung（推动）与 pytan（戳出）一支，更早词源不明；与拉丁语 putare（清点）无关，只是拼写相近
words.native_definition: to move something into a particular place or position
words.core_concept: moving a thing to where it will stay – 把东西挪到它该待的位置
words.core_image: 他把杯子从托盘上取下来，稳稳搁在桌子正中
examples: Put the box on the top shelf.
She put it very clearly indeed.
semantic_expansions: 放：把东西挪到某处停下
使处于：把人或事弄到某种境地，如置于险境
表述：把想法安放成话，轻重全在怎么摆
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ put（点算、估量）+ -ation → 众人反复估量之后给出的那个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 reputatio（反复估量、思量）← reputare：re-（反复）＋putare（清点、估算）
words.native_definition: the general opinion that people have about someone or something
words.core_concept: the figure others arrive at after weighing you up – 别人反复估量后给你定的那个数
words.core_image: 街坊提起那家铺子都点头，还没进门就知道秤准不准
examples: The school has a good reputation.
He ruined his reputation in a week.
semantic_expansions: 名声：外人对一个人是好是坏的普遍说法
声誉：长年积下来、被人认下的那份好评价

words.root_logic: form（形状）+ -at → formatus（被塑成的）→ 定下来的那个式样
words.origin: 法语 format（开本、式样）← 拉丁语 formatus（被塑成的）← formare ← forma（形状、模子）
words.native_definition: the way in which something is arranged or presented
words.core_concept: the settled shape a thing is put into – 一样东西被定下来的那个样子
words.core_image: 同一份文字排成三种样子，一种窄栏、一种通栏、一种折成小册
examples: Please send the file in another format.
He formatted the disk by mistake.
semantic_expansions: 格式：内容按哪一套规矩摆放
版式：一页上字与图的大小和位置安排
格式化：把介质重新划出格子，原有内容一并清掉

words.root_logic: forma（形状、模子）+ -ula（小）→ 一个小模子，照它套就出同样的东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 formula（小模子、定式），是 forma（形状、模子）的指小形
words.native_definition: a fixed set of symbols or words used to state a rule or recipe
words.core_concept: a small mould others can be cast in – 一个小模子，照它套就出同样的东西
words.core_image: 黑板上一行符号，谁把数字填进去都能算出同一个结果
examples: The teacher wrote the formula on the board.
The drink is made to a secret formula.
semantic_expansions: 公式：把一条规律写成可代入的符号串
配方：照定量配料做出同一样东西的那份单子
套话：说过多次、照模子填词的那种话

words.root_logic: formula（小模子、定式）+ -ate → 把散着的想法灌进模子，成一句站得住的话
words.origin: formula（定式）＋-ate；formula 是拉丁语 forma（形状、模子）的指小形
words.native_definition: to express an idea or plan clearly and in an exact form
words.core_concept: pouring loose thought into a fixed mould – 把散着的想法灌进定了型的模子
words.core_image: 一整晚在纸上划掉又重写，最后那句删到只剩十几个字
examples: She formulated her question with care.
The team formulated a new plan.
semantic_expansions: 明确表达：把含混的意思整成一句准确的话
制定：把做法一条条定成成文的方案

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pete（追求）→ 几个人一起朝同一样东西扑过去
words.origin: 拉丁语 competere（一同追求、相争）：com-（一起）＋petere（追求、索求）
words.native_definition: to try to win something or to be more successful than others
words.core_concept: several going after the same one thing – 几个人同时朝一样东西扑过去
words.core_image: 起跑线上八个人同时冲出去，终点只有一根带子
examples: Small shops cannot compete with big chains.
She competes for her country.
semantic_expansions: 竞争：跟别人抢同一样东西，如客户或名额
比赛：在定好的规则里比谁更强

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pet（追求）+ -itive → 属于一起抢那一样东西的，或抢得下来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 competitus（competere 的过去分词）← competere：com-（一起）＋petere（追求）
words.native_definition: involving rivalry, or good enough to do well against others
words.core_concept: in the scramble for the same thing – 处在同抢一样东西的那个局里
words.core_image: 一间铺子把价签改到比隔壁低两毛，隔壁当天也换了签
examples: The market is highly competitive.
He is very competitive at games.
semantic_expansions: 竞争的：这个场合本身就是几方相争
有竞争力的：条件够好，抢得过别人
好胜的：性子上事事都要争先

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ peat（追求、去取）→ 再去取一遍，同一件事又走一趟
words.origin: 古法语 repeter（重说、重做）← 拉丁语 repetere：re-（再）＋petere（追求、取）
words.native_definition: to say or do something again
words.core_concept: going after the same thing one more time – 同一样东西再去取一遍
words.core_image: 电话那头没听清，他又把同一串号码从头念了一遍
examples: Could you repeat the last word?
The channel showed a repeat of the match.
semantic_expansions: 重复：把同样的话或动作再做一次
重播：同一段节目再放一遍

words.root_logic: certi（已定的，← certus）+ -ficate（做成）→ 把'已经查定'做成一张纸
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 certificatum（已证明之物）← certificare：certus（已定的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: an official paper stating that a fact is true
words.core_concept: a paper that makes a fact settled – 把一件事做成'已定'的那张纸
words.core_image: 一张硬纸边上压着钢印，指腹摸过去有一圈凸起
examples: She framed her teaching certificate.
You need a birth certificate to apply.
semantic_expansions: 证书：证明学过、够格的那张正式纸
证明：为某项事实出具的书面凭据

words.root_logic: certi（已定的，← certus）+ -fy（使成为）→ 把还在摇摆的说法弄成定下的
words.origin: 古法语 certefier ← 晚期拉丁语 certificare（使确定）：certus（已定的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to state officially that something is true or meets a standard
words.core_concept: making a thing officially settled – 签个字把一件事定下来
words.core_image: 检验员看完仪表读数，在单子末尾签下名字，又压了一个印
examples: A doctor must certify the cause of death.
The lab certified the water as safe.
semantic_expansions: 证明：出面担保某事为真
认证：按标准查过后正式给出合格的判定

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cur（用心，← cura）+ -acy → 心思用足之后，处处都对得上
words.origin: 拉丁语 accuratio（用心、精细）← accuratus（费过心做出的）← accurare：ad-（朝向）＋cura（关切）
words.native_definition: the state of being exactly right
words.core_concept: what comes of taking pains – 心思用足之后处处对得上
words.core_image: 卡尺量过三遍，三次读数末位都一样，才写进单子
examples: The report's accuracy was checked twice.
He shoots with great accuracy.
semantic_expansions: 准确性：说法或数据与实情对得上的程度
精确度：测量或做工能细到哪一位

words.root_logic: se-（脱离）+ cure（挂心，← cura）→ securus：心上不必再挂着 → 拿得稳、不再疑
words.origin: 古法语 seur ← 拉丁语 securus：se-（脱离）＋cura（挂心、忧虑）——'无所挂心的'
words.native_definition: having no doubt that something is true or will happen
words.core_concept: nothing left to keep worrying about – 心里再没有要挂着的那件事
words.core_image: 出门前他没回头看门锁，钥匙在兜里响了一下就走了
examples: I am sure she will come.
Make sure the door is locked.
semantic_expansions: 确信的：心里认定如此，不再摇摆
肯定的：对一件事的判断不留余地
牢靠的：东西或办法稳当，不担心出岔

words.root_logic: fin（终结、结清）+ -ance + -ial → 与把账结到头那一摊有关的
words.origin: finance（← 中古法语 finance 结算 ← finer 终结、清账 ← 拉丁语 finis 界限、终点）＋-ial
words.native_definition: relating to money and the way it is managed
words.core_concept: to do with settling up – 与把账结到头有关
words.core_image: 桌上三本账簿摊开，最后一页两列数字终于对上，笔搁下了
examples: The company is in financial trouble.
She gave me financial advice.
semantic_expansions: 财务的：一家机构收支与账目那一摊
金融的：钱本身的融通与买卖那个行当

words.root_logic: fin（终点、界限）→ 做到了头、无可再加的；也指为了结一桩事一次付清的那一笔
words.origin: 古法语 fin（做到极处的、上等的）与中世纪拉丁语 finis（了结债务的那笔付款），同出拉丁语 finis（界限、终点）
words.native_definition: of high quality, or a sum of money paid as a penalty
words.core_concept: carried to the very end of a line – 走到线的尽头，或到尽头一次结清
words.core_image: 一块玉磨到再磨也磨不出更亮的那一步；另一张纸上写着停车超时要交多少钱
examples: This is a fine piece of silk.
He paid a fine for parking there.
semantic_expansions: 上等的：做到极处，再挑不出更好的
细的：分到极细的那一步，如细沙、细线
罚款：为了结一桩过失而交出去的那笔钱

words.root_logic: e-（出）+ merg（没入）+ -ency → 本来沉着看不见的事忽然冒出水面，逼你当下就应
words.origin: 拉丁语 emergentia（浮现）← emergens ← emergere：e-（出）＋mergere（没入水中）
words.native_definition: a sudden dangerous situation that must be dealt with at once
words.core_concept: what breaks the surface without warning – 忽然冒出水面、来不及等的那件事
words.core_image: 半夜走廊的红灯全亮起来，值班的人抓起外套就往楼梯口跑
examples: Call this number in an emergency.
She was taken to the emergency room.
semantic_expansions: 紧急情况：突然发生、必须立刻处置的局面
急诊：医院里专收这种当下就得治的那一科

words.root_logic: sub-（在下面）+ merge（没入）→ 按到水面以下去，直到看不出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 submergere：sub-（在下）＋mergere（浸入、没入）
words.native_definition: to go or to put something under the surface of water
words.core_concept: going down under the surface – 没到面下去
words.core_image: 河水涨过一夜，早上那排石阶连最上面一级都看不见了
examples: The boat submerged within minutes.
Floods submerged the whole village.
semantic_expansions: 淹没：水盖过某物，它就此看不见
下沉：整个没到水面以下去

words.root_logic: part（份，← pars）+ -ner（parçonier 分得一份的人）→ 与你分同一份的那个人
words.origin: 中古英语 partener，由 parcener（共分者）改拼而成 ← 古法语 parçonier ← 拉丁语 partitio（划分）← partire ← pars（部分）
words.native_definition: a person who shares work, business, or life with you
words.core_concept: the one who takes a share with you – 与你分同一份的那个人
words.core_image: 两人抬一张长桌，一头一个，谁松手另一头都得压下去
examples: She is my business partner.
He came to the party with his partner.
semantic_expansions: 伙伴：一同做事、共担一摊的人
合伙人：出资分利、共负盈亏的那一方
配偶：共过日子、分同一份家当的人

words.root_logic: part（分开，← pars）+ -y → 从整体分出来的那一伙人，或聚在一处的那一伙
words.origin: 古法语 partie（部分、一方）← partir（分开）← 拉丁语 partire ← pars（部分）
words.native_definition: a group with shared aims, one side in an agreement, or a social gathering
words.core_concept: a set split off from the whole – 从整体里分出来的那一伙
words.core_image: 一屋子人自然分成几堆，各堆手里端着同一种颜色的杯子
examples: The ruling party won again.
They threw a party for her birthday.
semantic_expansions: 党：主张相同、从众人里分出来的那一群
一方：契约或纠纷里对立的其中一边
聚会：一伙人聚在一处吃喝说笑

words.root_logic: portio（份，与 pars 同源）+ -ion → 按份切开后各得的那一块
words.origin: 古法语 porcion ← 拉丁语 portio（一份、份额），与 pars / partis（部分）同源；与 portare（运送）无关，同批族头误指为运送一支
words.native_definition: a part or share of something, especially of food
words.core_concept: the share that falls to one – 按份分下来落到各人手里的那一块
words.core_image: 一锅粥盛成六碗，每碗到同一道花纹处就停勺
examples: She ate only a small portion of the rice.
Each child gets an equal portion.
semantic_expansions: 一份：分给一个人的那个量，多用于食物
部分：整体里的一块，不是全部

words.root_logic: des-（离开）+ port（搬运，← portare）→ desporter：把心思从正事上搬开 → 消遣，后专指比力气的那类玩法
words.origin: 古法语 desporter（消遣、使人开心）：des-（离开）＋porter（搬、带）← 拉丁语 deportare ← portare（运送）；英语先作 disport，后截短为 sport
words.native_definition: a physical game or activity done for exercise or pleasure
words.core_concept: carrying the mind away from work – 把心思从正事上搬开
words.core_image: 下午四点操场上人跑成一片，书包全扔在树底下
examples: Football is his favourite sport.
They played sport every afternoon.
semantic_expansions: 运动：为了活动身体去做的那类事
体育：有规则、能比高下的那一整套活动
消遣：把注意力从正事上搬开的任何玩法

words.root_logic: bat（击打，← battuere）+ -ery → 一排炮一下接一下地砸；连排成组这层意思后来落到了蓄电装置上
words.origin: 古法语 batterie（击打、一组炮）← batre（打）← 拉丁语 battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a device that stores electricity, a set of guns, or the crime of hitting someone
words.core_concept: a row of things delivering blow after blow – 一排东西一下接一下地砸出去
words.core_image: 城墙外一排铁炮轮着响，隔几秒就有一发砸在同一处
examples: The car battery is flat again.
He was charged with assault and battery.
semantic_expansions: 电池：一组单元串在一处连续供电，'连排成组'那层留了下来
炮组：连排在一起、轮番开火的那些火炮
殴打：法律上指一下下动手打人

words.root_logic: circul（小环，← circulus）+ -ate → 沿着环走一圈，又回到起点
words.origin: 拉丁语 circulari（成环、绕行）← circulus（小环）← circus（圆圈）
words.native_definition: to move round a closed path, or to pass from person to person
words.core_concept: going round and coming back to the start – 绕一圈回到出发那一点
words.core_image: 暖气管里的水从锅炉出去，绕过一圈屋子又回到锅炉口
examples: Blood circulates through the body.
The rumour circulated fast.
semantic_expansions: 循环：沿闭合的路一圈圈走，回到原处再来
流通：钱或空气在一个范围里来回走动
传阅：一份东西在人手里挨个转一遍

words.root_logic: cult（耕作、照管，← colere）+ -ivate → 年年翻这块地、照管到它长出东西；本事和关系也这么养
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cultivare ← cultivus（可耕的）← 拉丁语 cultus ← colere（耕作、住下照管）
words.native_definition: to prepare and use land for crops, or to develop something by care
words.core_concept: tending the same ground until it yields – 守着同一块地照管到它出东西
words.core_image: 一块荒地被人年年翻整，第三季垄上冒出成片的苗
examples: They cultivate rice on the hillside.
She cultivated a habit of reading.
semantic_expansions: 耕种：翻土下种，把生地做熟
培养：像照管地一样，把习惯或本事养出来
结交：花心思一点点把关系养起来

words.root_logic: of-（ob- 的变体，对着）+ fens（击，← -fendere）+ -ive → 一下撞到人身上的，或主动打出去的那一路
words.origin: 古法语 offensif ← 中世纪拉丁语 offensivus ← 拉丁语 offendere（撞上、触犯）：ob-（朝向）＋-fendere（击）
words.native_definition: causing anger or hurt, or connected with attacking
words.core_concept: a blow struck at someone – 朝人身上打出去的那一下
words.core_image: 一句话出口，屋里人脸色都变了，被说的那个站起来就往外走
examples: His remarks were deeply offensive.
The army launched an offensive at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 无礼的：话或举动像迎面一击，撞了人
令人不快的：气味、画面之类让人受不了
攻势的：属于主动进攻那一路，与守相对

words.root_logic: gen（生、种类）+ -der（← genus 的斜格 gener-）→ 按'生成哪一类'分出来的那一档
words.origin: 古法语 gendre（种类）← 拉丁语 genus（属格 generis：种、类），与 gignere（生）同支
words.native_definition: the state of being male or female, or a class of nouns in grammar
words.core_concept: which kind a thing was born into – 生来被归进哪一类
words.core_image: 表格上那一栏只给两个方框，填表的人在其中一个里打了勾
examples: The form asks for your gender.
German nouns have three genders.
semantic_expansions: 性别：人或动物按雌雄分成的那一类
语法性：某些语言里名词分成的阴阳中几类

words.root_logic: just（合于法的，← jus 法、准）→ 不偏不倚、正对准 → 恰好、刚刚
words.origin: 古法语 juste ← 拉丁语 justus（合法的、正当的）← jus（法、权利）；副词'恰好、刚才'义由'正对准'引申
words.native_definition: exactly or only, or acting in a fair way
words.core_concept: sitting exactly on the mark – 正落在那道准线上
words.core_image: 秤杆抬起来，两头齐平，指针停在正中那一道刻线上
examples: She left just a minute ago.
It was a just decision.
semantic_expansions: 恰好：不多不少，正对上那个点
仅仅：只到这个限，再没有别的
公正的：依准而断，不偏向任何一边

words.root_logic: im-（in- 的变体，不）+ mune（公共职役，← munus）→ 不必分担那一份 → 免于，进而指外物侵不进来
words.origin: 拉丁语 immunis（免役的、免税的）：in-（不）＋munus（公共职役、赋税）；munus 也是 communis（共有的）的后一半
words.native_definition: protected against a disease, or free from something unpleasant
words.core_concept: left out of the common burden – 公共那一份摊派不到他身上
words.core_image: 一村人都摊派了徭役，只有一户门上贴着条子，收册的人过门不入
examples: She is immune to measles.
He seems immune to criticism.
semantic_expansions: 免疫的：身体里已有防备，病侵不进来
不受影响的：外面的压力或指责落不到身上

words.root_logic: nurs（喂养、照看，← nutrire）+ -ery（处所）→ 专管把小的喂大的那个地方
words.origin: 古法语 norricerie（哺育之处）← norrice（奶妈）← 晚期拉丁语 nutricia ← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养、养大）
words.native_definition: a place where young children are looked after, or where plants are raised
words.core_concept: the room where small things are fed until they grow – 专门把小的喂大的那个地方
words.core_image: 一排小床挨着窗，墙角摞着奶瓶；另一处棚下一格格小盆里插着刚发芽的枝
examples: She leaves the baby at a nursery.
They bought the tree from a nursery.
semantic_expansions: 托儿所：白天替人看小孩、喂饭哄睡的地方
苗圃：把树苗一格格养到能移栽的那片地
育儿室：家里专给婴儿睡和喂的那间屋

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，从下面）+ ply（填满，← plere）→ 从底下把缺的那块添齐
words.origin: 中古英语 supplien ← 古法语 souploier / soupleer ← 拉丁语 supplere（补足、填满）：sub-（从下）＋plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to give someone something they need, or the amount available
words.core_concept: filling up from underneath what is short – 从底下把缺的那块添齐
words.core_image: 货架上空出一段，理货员从后仓推来一车，一件件把那段填平
examples: The town supplies water to nearby villages.
Food supplies ran low.
semantic_expansions: 供应：把别人缺的东西送到手
补给：往已经见底的那一份里续上
供应量：眼下能拿出来的那个总数

words.root_logic: re（res 的变体，事物）+ public（属于众人的，← publicus）+ -an → 主张国事归众人的那一派或那种人
words.origin: 法语 républicain ← republic ← 拉丁语 res publica：res（事物）＋publica（公共的）← publicus ← populus（人民）
words.native_definition: supporting a state without a monarch, or a member of such a party
words.core_concept: holding that the state's business belongs to all – 国事是众人之事
words.core_image: 广场上一群人把王冠的画像取下来，换上一张写满签名的纸
examples: He holds strong republican views.
She votes Republican every time.
semantic_expansions: 共和的：国家不设君主，权由众人所出
共和派：主张这一套政体的那一群人
共和党人：某国共和党的成员或支持者

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ side（坐，← sedere）→ 坐在众人前面那个位子上掌事
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesidere（坐在前面、主持）：prae-（在前）＋sedere（坐）
words.native_definition: to be in charge of a meeting or ceremony
words.core_concept: sitting in the seat at the front – 坐在最前面那个位子上
words.core_image: 长桌一端那把椅子空着，直到有人走过去坐下，众人才安静
examples: The judge presided over the trial.
She presided at the annual meeting.
semantic_expansions: 主持：坐在前面掌着一场会或仪式的进程
担任主席：正式占着那个首位的职分

words.root_logic: re-（往回、持续）+ tent（握住，← tenere）+ -ion → 一直攥着不放这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 retentio（保持、扣住）← retentus ← retinere：re-（往回）＋tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: the act of keeping something rather than losing it or giving it up
words.core_concept: keeping a grip and not letting go – 攥住不放开
words.core_image: 一只手把绳头攥在掌心，另一头有人拽，掌心的绳一寸也没滑出去
examples: The school works on staff retention.
Water retention made her ankles swell.
semantic_expansions: 保持：把人或物留在手里，不让它流失
记忆力：把学过的东西攥住不忘的那份能力
滞留：本该排出去的东西留在体内没走

words.root_logic: syn-（一起）+ thet（放置，← tithenai）+ -ic → 把几样东西放到一处拼成的，不是自己长出来的
words.origin: 法语 synthétique ← 希腊语 sunthetikos（善于组合的）← suntithenai：sun-（一起）＋tithenai（放置）
words.native_definition: made by combining substances, rather than produced naturally
words.core_concept: put together out of separate parts – 由几样东西凑放到一处做成
words.core_image: 一块布摸上去比棉滑，烧一角起了黑珠，不成灰
examples: The jacket is made of synthetic fibre.
This rubber is synthetic.
semantic_expansions: 合成的：把几种物质放到一起造出来的
人造的：不是自然生成，人手拼出来的那种

words.root_logic: turb（搅乱、旋动，← turba）+ -ulent（多…的）→ 里头一直翻着旋涡，静不下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 turbulentus（骚动的、混乱的）← turba（拥挤的人群、混乱）
words.native_definition: moving in a violent, unsteady way, or full of disorder
words.core_concept: churning without ever settling – 里头一直翻搅，定不下来
words.core_image: 飞机进了云层，杯里的水一路往外泼，机身上下颠了几十下
examples: The plane hit turbulent air.
They lived through turbulent years.
semantic_expansions: 湍急的：水或气流卷着旋涡乱冲
动荡的：一段时期里局面反复翻覆
骚乱的：人群挤成一团，秩序散掉

words.root_logic: dis-（取消）+ re-（再）+ gard（看守、注目，← *wardon）→ 把那道目光收回去，看也不看
words.origin: dis-（取消）＋regard ← 古法语 regarder（注视）：re-（再）＋garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon（守望）
words.native_definition: to pay no attention to something, or a lack of attention
words.core_concept: taking the eyes off it on purpose – 把目光收回去，不再看它
words.core_image: 桌上那张通知他扫了一眼就推到一边，继续写自己的东西
examples: He disregarded the doctor's advice.
She showed complete disregard for the rules.
semantic_expansions: 忽视：该看的没看，把它放过去了
不顾：明知有规矩或危险还是不管
漠视：知道却当没看见，态度上不当回事

words.root_logic: 拉丁语 minus（更小、更少）直接入英语 → 让数目变小的那个记号 → 减去
words.origin: 拉丁语 minus（更少、更小），minor（更小的）的中性比较级；数学用法 15 世纪自拉丁语算书借入
words.native_definition: used to show that one number is being subtracted from another
words.core_concept: reduction by an amount – 从一个量里取走一部分
words.core_image: 账单上一行写着 100 减 20，笔尖点在那道短横上，数目往下走
examples: Seven minus three equals four.
The plan has one minus we should discuss.
